          (∀ (s : SKEFTHawking.APSEta.Substrate),
            And (SKEFTHawking.APSEta.IsChirallyAsymmetric s)

        (fun isLt isLt_1 => instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv rho cs) (Real.instNeg.neg v))
        (fun isLt isLt_1 => instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv rho cs) (Real.instNeg.neg v))
        (fun isLt isLt_1 => instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv rho cs) 1) (fun i hi x => absurd hi ⋯) fun x j hj =>
        absurd hj ⋯)

name: SKEFTHawking.AcousticMetric.dAlembertian.eq_1
type:
∀ (v cs rho : Real → Real) (pi_field : SKEFTHawking.Spacetime1D → Real) (p : SKEFTHawking.Spacetime1D),
  Eq (SKEFTHawking.AcousticMetric.dAlembertian v cs rho pi_field p)
    (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (rho p.x))
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (SKEFTHawking.AcousticMetric.partialT
          (fun q =>
            instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv (-1) (cs q.x)) (SKEFTHawking.AcousticMetric.partialT pi_field q))
              (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv (Real.instNeg.neg (v q.x)) (cs q.x))
                (SKEFTHawking.AcousticMetric.partialX pi_field q)))
          p)
        (SKEFTHawking.AcousticMetric.partialX
          (fun q =>
            instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv (Real.instNeg.neg (v q.x)) (cs q.x))
                (SKEFTHawking.AcousticMetric.partialT pi_field q))

  [inst_4 : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_6 : IsManifold I (minSmoothness 𝕜 3) M]

  (cov :
    ((x : M) → TangentSpace I x) → (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id 𝕜) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x)),
  (∀ (V W : (x : M) → TangentSpace I x) (x : M),

        (VectorField.mlieBracket I V W x)) →
    (∀ (σ τ : (x : M) → TangentSpace I x) (x : M), Eq (cov (instHSub.hSub σ τ) x) (instHSub.hSub (cov σ x) (cov τ x))) →
      ∀ (X Y Z : (x : M) → TangentSpace I x) (x : M),
        ContMDiffAt I I.tangent (minSmoothness 𝕜 2) (fun x => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E x (X x)) x →
          ContMDiffAt I I.tangent (minSmoothness 𝕜 2) (fun x => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E x (Y x)) x →
            ContMDiffAt I I.tangent (minSmoothness 𝕜 2) (fun x => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E x (Z x)) x →
              MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent (fun x₀ => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E x₀ (VectorField.mlieBracket I Z X x₀))
                  x →
                Eq
                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (SKEFTHawking.BundleRiemannAux.bundleRiemannAux cov X Y Z x)
                      (SKEFTHawking.BundleRiemannAux.bundleRiemannAux cov Y Z X x))
                    (SKEFTHawking.BundleRiemannAux.bundleRiemannAux cov Z X Y x))
                  0

  [CompleteSpace E]
  (cov :
    ((x : M) → TangentSpace I x) → (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id 𝕜) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x)),
  IsCovariantDerivativeOn E cov →
    (∀ (V W : (x : M) → TangentSpace I x) (x : M),
        Eq
          (instHSub.hSub (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (cov W x) (V x))
            (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (cov V x) (W x)))
          (VectorField.mlieBracket I V W x)) →
      ∀ (X Y Z : (x : M) → TangentSpace I x) (x : M),
        ContMDiffAt I I.tangent (minSmoothness 𝕜 2) (fun x => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E x (X x)) x →

            ContMDiffAt I I.tangent (minSmoothness 𝕜 2) (fun x => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E x (Z x)) x →
              MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent (fun x₀ => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E x₀ (VectorField.mlieBracket I Z X x₀))
                  x →
                MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent
                    (fun y => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E y (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (cov Z y) (Y y))) x →
                  MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent
                      (fun y => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E y (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (cov Y y) (Z y))) x →
                    MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent
                        (fun y => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E y (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (cov Z y) (X y))) x →
                      MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent
                          (fun y => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E y (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (cov X y) (Z y))) x →
                        MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent
                            (fun y => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E y (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (cov X y) (Y y))) x →
                          MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent
                              (fun y => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E y (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (cov Y y) (X y))) x →
                            Eq
                              (instHAdd.hAdd
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (SKEFTHawking.BundleRiemannAux.bundleRiemannAux cov X Y Z x)
                                  (SKEFTHawking.BundleRiemannAux.bundleRiemannAux cov Y Z X x))

                              0

            (∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space), DifferentiableAt Real (fun s => v { fst := s, snd := x }) t) →
              (HasCompactSupport fun x => instHSub.hSub u v { fst := t, snd := x }) →

name: SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedCompact.forced_integrating_factor
type:
∀ {T : Real} {k H E E' : Real → Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 T →
    ContinuousOn k (Set.Icc 0 T) →
      ContinuousOn H (Set.Icc 0 T) →
        ContinuousOn E (Set.Icc 0 T) →
          (∀ (t : Real), Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 T) t → HasDerivAt E (E' t) t) →
            (∀ (t : Real),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 T) t →
                  Real.instLE.le (E' t) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (k t) (E t)) (H t))) →
              ∀ (t : Real),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 T) t →
                  Real.instLE.le (E t)
                    (instHMul.hMul (Real.exp (intervalIntegral (fun s => k s) 0 t Real.measureSpace.volume))
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (E 0)
                        (intervalIntegral
                          (fun s =>
                            instHMul.hMul
                              (Real.exp
                                (Real.instNeg.neg (intervalIntegral (fun r => k r) 0 s Real.measureSpace.volume)))
                              (H s))
                          0 t Real.measureSpace.volume)))

type:

    ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) u (NavierStokesR3.Comparison.slab 0 T) →

            IsCompact K →
              (∀ (r : Real),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 T) r →
                    Set.instLE.le (tsupport fun x => instHSub.hSub u v { fst := r, snd := x }) K) →
                (∀ (t : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 T) t →
                      ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                        Eq (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence u t x) 0) →
                  (∀ (t : Real),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 T) t →
                        ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                          Eq (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence v t x) 0) →
                    ∀ {g H : Real → Real},
                      ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc 0 T) →
                        ContinuousOn H (Set.Icc 0 T) →
                          (∀ (t : Real),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 T) t →
                                ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                                  Real.instLE.le
                                    (ContinuousLinearMap.hasOpNorm.norm
                                      (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDerivative u t x))
                                    (g t)) →
                            (∀ (t : Real),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 T) t →
                                  MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                    (fun x =>
                                      instHPow.hPow
                                        ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm
                                          (SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.residualDifference u v p q t x))
                                        2)
                                    measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume) →

                                        instHPow.hPow

                                            (SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.residualDifference u v p q t x))
                                          2)
                                      (H t)) →

                                  ∀ (t : Real),
                                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 T) t →
                                      Real.instLE.le (NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.l2Sq (instHSub.hSub u v) t)
                                        (instHMul.hMul
                                          (Real.exp
                                            (intervalIntegral (fun s => instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (g s)) η) 0 t
                                              Real.measureSpace.volume))
                                          (instHAdd.hAdd (NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.l2Sq (instHSub.hSub u v) 0)
                                            (instHMul.hMul (Real.instInv.inv η)
                                              (intervalIntegral
                                                (fun s =>
                                                  instHMul.hMul
                                                    (Real.exp
                                                      (Real.instNeg.neg
                                                        (intervalIntegral
                                                          (fun r => instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (g r)) η) 0 s
                                                          Real.measureSpace.volume)))

                                                0 t Real.measureSpace.volume))))

name: SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedCompact.stream_witness_stability
type:
∀ {T η : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 T →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
      Exists fun G =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 G)
          (∀ (t : Real),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 T) t →
              Real.instLE.le
                (NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.l2Sq SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedCompact.streamVelocity t)
                (instHMul.hMul (Real.exp (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 G) η) t))
                  (instHMul.hMul (Real.instInv.inv η)
                    (intervalIntegral
                      (fun s =>
                        instHMul.hMul
                          (Real.exp (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 G) η) s)))
                          (NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.l2Sq SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedCompact.streamForce s))
                      0 t Real.measureSpace.volume))))

name: SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedCompact.work_bound

  Continuous w →
    HasCompactSupport w →
      Continuous F →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => instHPow.hPow ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm (F x)) 2)
            measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume →
          Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
            Real.instLE.le
              (instHMul.hMul 2
                (MeasureTheory.integral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun x =>
                  (PiLp.innerProductSpace fun x => Real).inner Real (w x) (F x)))
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (instHMul.hMul η
                  (MeasureTheory.integral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun x =>
                    instHPow.hPow ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm (w x)) 2))
                (instHMul.hMul (Real.instInv.inv η)
                  (MeasureTheory.integral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun x =>
                    instHPow.hPow ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm (F x)) 2)))

name: SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedCompact.zero_force_stability
type:
∀ {T : Real} {u v : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField} {p q : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.PressureField}
  {K : Set NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space},
  Real.instLE.le 0 T →
    ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) u (NavierStokesR3.Comparison.slab 0 T) →
      ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) v (NavierStokesR3.Comparison.slab 0 T) →
        ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) p (NavierStokesR3.Comparison.slab 0 T) →
          ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) q (NavierStokesR3.Comparison.slab 0 T) →
            IsCompact K →
              (∀ (r : Real),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 T) r →
                    Set.instLE.le (tsupport fun x => instHSub.hSub u v { fst := r, snd := x }) K) →
                (∀ (t : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 T) t →
                      ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                        Eq (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence u t x) 0) →
                  (∀ (t : Real),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 T) t →
                        ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                          Eq (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence v t x) 0) →
                    ∀ {g : Real → Real},
                      ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc 0 T) →
                        (∀ (t : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 T) t →
                              ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                                Real.instLE.le
                                  (ContinuousLinearMap.hasOpNorm.norm
                                    (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDerivative u t x))
                                  (g t)) →
                          (∀ (t : Real),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 T) t →
                                ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                                  Eq (SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.residualDifference u v p q t x) 0) →
                            ∀ (t : Real),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 T) t →
                                Real.instLE.le (NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.l2Sq (instHSub.hSub u v) t)
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (Real.exp
                                      (intervalIntegral (fun s => instHMul.hMul 2 (g s)) 0 t Real.measureSpace.volume))
                                    (NavierStokesR3.CompactEnergy.l2Sq (instHSub.hSub u v) 0))

name: SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.equal_residual_balance_recovery
type:
∀ {χ : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space → Real} {u v : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField}
  {p q : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.PressureField} {t : Real},
  ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) χ →
    HasCompactSupport χ →
      (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun x => u { fst := t, snd := x }) →
        (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun x => v { fst := t, snd := x }) →
          (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun x => p { fst := t, snd := x }) →
            (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun x => q { fst := t, snd := x }) →
              (∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                  DifferentiableAt Real (fun r => u { fst := r, snd := x }) t) →
                (∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                    DifferentiableAt Real (fun r => v { fst := r, snd := x }) t) →
                  (∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                      Eq (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence u t x) 0) →
                    (∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                        Eq (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence v t x) 0) →
                      (∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                          Eq (NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual 1 u p t x)
                            (NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual 1 v q t x)) →
                        Eq
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul (1 / 2)
                              (NavierStokesR3.Comparison.weightedEnergyRate χ (instHSub.hSub u v) t))
                            (NavierStokesR3.Comparison.weightedDissipation χ (instHSub.hSub u v) t))
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                              (instHAdd.hAdd
                                (Real.instNeg.neg
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun x =>
                                    instHMul.hMul (χ x)
                                      ((PiLp.innerProductSpace fun x => Real).inner Real
                                        (instHSub.hSub u v { fst := t, snd := x })
                                        (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                                          (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDerivative u t x)
                                          (instHSub.hSub u v { fst := t, snd := x })))))
                                (instHMul.hMul (1 / 2)
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun x =>
                                    instHMul.hMul
                                      (instHPow.hPow
                                        ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm
                                          (instHSub.hSub u v { fst := t, snd := x }))
                                        2)
                                      (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                                        NavierStokes.PeriodicIntegration.spatialPartial i
                                          (NavierStokes.PeriodicIntegration.spatialPartial i χ) x))))
                              (instHMul.hMul (1 / 2)
                                (MeasureTheory.integral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun x =>
                                  instHMul.hMul
                                    (instHPow.hPow
                                      ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm (instHSub.hSub u v { fst := t, snd := x }))
                                      2)
                                    (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real χ x) (v { fst := t, snd := x })))))
                            (MeasureTheory.integral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun x =>
                              instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub p q { fst := t, snd := x })
                                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real χ x)
                                  (instHSub.hSub u v { fst := t, snd := x }))))

name: SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.forceWork.eq_1
type:
∀ (χ : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space → Real) (w : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField)
  (F : Real → NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space → NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space) (t : Real),
  Eq (SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.forceWork χ w F t)
    (MeasureTheory.integral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun x =>
      instHMul.hMul (χ x) ((PiLp.innerProductSpace fun x => Real).inner Real (w { fst := t, snd := x }) (F t x)))

name: SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.forceWork_bound
type:
∀ {χ : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space → Real} {w : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField}
  {F : Real → NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space → NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space} {t η : Real},
  Continuous χ →
    HasCompactSupport χ →
      (∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space), Real.instLE.le 0 (χ x)) →
        (∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space), Real.instLE.le (χ x) 1) →
          (Continuous fun x => w { fst := t, snd := x }) →
            Continuous (F t) →
              MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => instHPow.hPow ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm (F t x)) 2)
                  measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume →
                Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 (abs (SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.forceWork χ w F t)))
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul η (NavierStokesR3.Comparison.weightedEnergy χ w t))
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instInv.inv η)
                        (MeasureTheory.integral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun x =>
                          instHPow.hPow ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm (F t x)) 2)))

name: SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.forced_difference_equation
type:
∀ {u v : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField} {p q : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.PressureField} {t : Real}
  {x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space},
  (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun y => u { fst := t, snd := y }) →
    (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun y => v { fst := t, snd := y }) →
      (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun y => p { fst := t, snd := y }) →
        (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun y => q { fst := t, snd := y }) →
          DifferentiableAt Real (fun s => u { fst := s, snd := x }) t →
            DifferentiableAt Real (fun s => v { fst := s, snd := x }) t →
              Eq (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.temporalDerivative (instHSub.hSub u v) t x)
                (instHAdd.hAdd
                  (instHSub.hSub
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHSub.hSub (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialLaplacian (instHSub.hSub u v) t x)
                        (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDerivative u t x)
                          (instHSub.hSub u v { fst := t, snd := x })))
                      (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                        (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDerivative (instHSub.hSub u v) t x)
                        (v { fst := t, snd := x })))
                    (NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.pressureGradient (instHSub.hSub p q) t x))
                  (SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.residualDifference u v p q t x))

name: SKEFTHawking.ClassicalFlowForcedLocalized.forced_energy_balance
type:
∀ {χ : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space → Real} {u v : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField}
  {p q : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.PressureField} {t : Real},
  ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) χ →

type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real F] [CompleteSpace F] {v : F → F}
  {K L : NNReal},
  LipschitzWith K v →
    (∀ (x : F), Real.instLE.le (inst.norm (v x)) L.toReal) →
      ∀ {φ : ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) F Real} {c : Real},
        Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
          (∀ (x : F), Real.instLE.le c (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe φ (v x))) →
            ∀ {x₀ : F},
              Real.instLE.le 0 (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe φ x₀) →
                ∀ {ε : Real},
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
                    Exists fun α =>
                      And (Eq (α 0) x₀)
                        (And
                          (∀ (t : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 ε) t → HasDerivWithinAt α (v (α t)) (Set.Icc 0 ε) t)
                          (And
                            (∀ (t : Real),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 ε) t →
                                Real.instLE.le 0 (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe φ (α t)))
                            (∀ (t : Real),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ε) t →
                                Real.instLT.lt 0 (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe φ (α t)))))

    (∀ (x : F), Real.instLE.le (inst.norm (v x)) L.toReal) →
      ∀ {φ : ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) F Real} {c : Real},
        (∀ (x : F), Real.instLE.le c (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe φ (v x))) →
          ∀ (x₀ : F) {ε : Real},
            Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
              Exists fun α =>
                And (Eq (α 0) x₀)
                  (And
                    (∀ (t : Real),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 ε) t → HasDerivWithinAt α (v (α t)) (Set.Icc 0 ε) t)
                    (∀ (t : Real),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 ε) t →

name: SKEFTHawking.Control.bsAntiderivative.eq_1
type:
∀ (ω Ω φ a b c d t : Real),
  Eq (SKEFTHawking.Control.bsAntiderivative ω Ω φ a b c d t)
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (instHSMul.hSMul
          (Complex.ofReal
            (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv Ω ω)
              (instHSub.hSub (Real.sin (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul ω t) φ)) (Real.sin φ))))
          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHSMul.hSMul (Complex.ofReal a) 1) (instHSMul.hSMul (Complex.ofReal d) SKEFTHawking.σ_z)))
        (instHSMul.hSMul
          (Complex.ofReal
            (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv Ω (instHMul.hMul 4 ω))
              (instHSub.hSub
                (instHMul.hMul b
                  (instHSub.hSub (Real.sin (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 ω) t) φ)) (Real.sin φ)))
                (instHMul.hMul c
                  (instHSub.hSub (Real.cos (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 ω) t) φ)) (Real.cos φ))))))
          SKEFTHawking.σ_x))
      (instHSMul.hSMul
        (Complex.ofReal
          (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv Ω (instHMul.hMul 4 ω))
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHMul.hMul b
                (instHSub.hSub (Real.cos (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 ω) t) φ)) (Real.cos φ)))
              (instHMul.hMul c
                (instHSub.hSub (Real.sin (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 ω) t) φ)) (Real.sin φ))))))
        SKEFTHawking.σ_y))

  {V : Fin 2 → (Real → Real) → Real} {s hf : Real → Real} {μ₀ μ₁ σ t : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 kB →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 T →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 m.G →
        SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsUncorrelatedAt Finset.univ Vtot V →
          SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel.IsThermalFluctuationLimited (V 0) m kB T Tw →
            SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsWhiteFilteredVariance (V 1) (instHPow.hPow (m.johnsonNEP kB T) 2) Tw →
              Real.instLE.le 0 Tw →
                SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsAdmissibleFilter Tw s hf →
                  IntervalIntegrable (fun x => instHPow.hPow (s x) 2) Real.measureSpace.volume 0 Tw →
                    Real.instLT.lt 0 σ →
                      Real.instLE.le μ₀ μ₁ →
                        Eq (instHSub.hSub μ₁ μ₀)
                            (intervalIntegral (fun x => instHMul.hMul (hf x) (s x)) 0 Tw Real.measureSpace.volume) →

                              (instHSub.hSub 1
                                (SKEFTHawking.Detection.gaussianQ
                                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                                    (SKEFTHawking.Detection.matchedBudget
                                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (m.phononNEP kB T) 2)

name: SKEFTHawking.Control.relaxation_detector_chain_ceiling
type:
∀ {t T1 e0 e1 : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 t →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 T1 →
      Real.instLE.le 0 e0 →
        Real.instLE.le (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.readoutDecayProb t T1) e1 →
          ∀ (m : SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel) {kB T Tw : Real} {Vtot : (Real → Real) → Real}
            {V : Fin 2 → (Real → Real) → Real} {s hf : Real → Real} {μ₀ μ₁ σ tThr : Real},
            Real.instLT.lt 0 kB →
              Real.instLT.lt 0 T →
                Real.instLT.lt 0 m.G →
                  SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsUncorrelatedAt Finset.univ Vtot V →
                    SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel.IsThermalFluctuationLimited (V 0) m kB T Tw →
                      SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsWhiteFilteredVariance (V 1) (instHPow.hPow (m.johnsonNEP kB T) 2) Tw →
                        Real.instLE.le 0 Tw →
                          SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsAdmissibleFilter Tw s hf →
                            IntervalIntegrable (fun x => instHPow.hPow (s x) 2) Real.measureSpace.volume 0 Tw →
                              Real.instLT.lt 0 σ →
                                Real.instLE.le μ₀ μ₁ →
                                  Eq (instHSub.hSub μ₁ μ₀)
                                      (intervalIntegral (fun x => instHMul.hMul (hf x) (s x)) 0 Tw
                                        Real.measureSpace.volume) →
                                    Eq σ (Vtot hf).sqrt →
                                      Real.instLE.le (SKEFTHawking.Detection.thrErr0 μ₀ σ tThr) e0 →
                                        Real.instLE.le (SKEFTHawking.Detection.thrErr1 μ₁ σ tThr) e1 →
                                          Real.instLE.le (SKEFTHawking.Control.assignmentFidelity e0 e1)
                                            (instHSub.hSub 1
                                              (Real.instMax.max
                                                (instHDiv.hDiv (instHDiv.hDiv t T1)
                                                  (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (instHDiv.hDiv t T1))))
                                                (SKEFTHawking.Detection.gaussianQ
                                                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                                                    (SKEFTHawking.Detection.matchedBudget
                                                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (m.phononNEP kB T) 2)
                                                        (instHPow.hPow (m.johnsonNEP kB T) 2))
                                                      Tw s)
                                                    2))))

name: SKEFTHawking.Control.relaxation_dominates_photon_at_separation_99

name: SKEFTHawking.Control.rwa_propagator_difference_bound
type:
∀ {L U P Q : Real → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) Complex} {Ur : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) Complex}
  {KL KU KUr Kp Kq T ω Ω φ a b c d : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ω →
    Real.instLE.le 0 Ω →
      (∀ (s : Real), HasDerivAt L (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (L s) (P s)) s) →
        (∀ (s : Real), HasDerivAt U (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (Q s) (U s)) s) →
          (∀ (s : Real),
              HasDerivAt
                (fun r =>
                  instHSMul.hSMul (Complex.instNeg.neg Complex.I)
                    (SKEFTHawking.Control.bsAntiderivative ω Ω φ a b c d r))
                (instHAdd.hAdd (P s) (Q s)) s) →
            Continuous L →
              Continuous U →
                Continuous P →
                  Continuous Q →
                    Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (L 0) (U 0)) 1 →
                      (∀ (s : Real), Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm (L s)) KL) →
                        (∀ (s : Real), Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm (U s)) KU) →
                          (∀ (s : Real), Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm (P s)) Kp) →
                            (∀ (s : Real), Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm (Q s)) Kq) →
                              Real.instLE.le 0 T →
                                Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul Ur (L T)) 1 →
                                  Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm Ur) KUr →
                                    Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm (instHSub.hSub (U T) Ur))
                                      (instHMul.hMul KUr
                                        (instHMul.hMul
                                          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul KL KU)
                                            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHDiv.hDiv Ω ω))
                                              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (abs a) (abs b)) (abs c))
                                                (abs d))))
                                          (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (instHMul.hMul T (instHAdd.hAdd Kp Kq)))))

        Real.instLE.le
          (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm (instHSub.hSub (SKEFTHawking.Control.commutingDrivePropagator ω Ω φ a T) 1))
          (instHMul.hMul 1
            (instHMul.hMul
              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 1 1)
                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHDiv.hDiv Ω ω))
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (abs a) (abs 0)) (abs 0)) (abs 0))))
              (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (instHMul.hMul T (instHAdd.hAdd 0 (instHMul.hMul Ω (abs a)))))))

name: SKEFTHawking.Control.rwa_propagator_difference_bound_physical
type:
∀ (ω₀ ω Ω φ a b c d T KL KU KUr Kp Kq : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ω →
    Real.instLE.le 0 Ω →
      Real.instLE.le 0 T →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 (SKEFTHawking.Control.rwaRate (instHSub.hSub ω₀ ω) Ω b c) →
          ∀ (U : Real → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) Complex),
            (∀ (s : Real),
                HasDerivAt U
                  (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                    (instHSMul.hSMul (Complex.instNeg.neg Complex.I)
                      (SKEFTHawking.Control.interactionHamiltonian ω₀ ω Ω φ a b c d s))
                    (U s))
                  s) →
              Eq (U 0) 1 →
                Continuous U →
                  (∀ (s : Real),
                      Real.instLE.le
                        (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm
                          (SKEFTHawking.Control.rwaPropagator ω₀ ω Ω φ b c (Real.instNeg.neg s)))
                        KL) →
                    (∀ (s : Real), Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm (U s)) KU) →
                      Real.instLE.le
                          (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm
                            (instHSMul.hSMul Complex.I (SKEFTHawking.Control.rwaGenerator ω₀ ω Ω φ b c)))
                          Kp →
                        (∀ (s : Real),
                            Real.instLE.le
                              (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm
                                (instHSMul.hSMul (Complex.instNeg.neg Complex.I)
                                  (SKEFTHawking.Control.interactionHamiltonian ω₀ ω Ω φ a b c d s)))
                              Kq) →
                          Real.instLE.le
                              (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm (SKEFTHawking.Control.rwaPropagator ω₀ ω Ω φ b c T)) KUr →
                            Real.instLE.le
                              (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm
                                (instHSub.hSub (U T) (SKEFTHawking.Control.rwaPropagator ω₀ ω Ω φ b c T)))
                              (instHMul.hMul KUr
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul KL KU)
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHDiv.hDiv Ω ω))
                                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (abs a) (abs b)) (abs c)) (abs d))))
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (instHMul.hMul T (instHAdd.hAdd Kp Kq)))))

      Eq
        (SKEFTHawking.EinsteinTensor.einsteinTensor
          (SKEFTHawking.Curvature.ricciOf (SKEFTHawking.Curvature.constantSectionalRiemann K g))
          (SKEFTHawking.Curvature.scalarOf

name: SKEFTHawking.EinsteinTensor.constantSectional_lambda_vacuum_iff
type:
∀ (K Λ : Real) (g g_inv : SKEFTHawking.Curvature.MetricMatrix),
  Eq (SKEFTHawking.Curvature.sumFin4 fun μ => SKEFTHawking.Curvature.sumFin4 fun ν => instHMul.hMul (g_inv μ ν) (g μ ν))
      4 →
    ∀ (μ₀ ν₀ : Fin 4),
      Ne (g μ₀ ν₀) 0 →
        Iff
          (∀ (μ ν : Fin 4),
            Eq
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (SKEFTHawking.EinsteinTensor.einsteinTensor
                  (SKEFTHawking.Curvature.ricciOf (SKEFTHawking.Curvature.constantSectionalRiemann K g))
                  (SKEFTHawking.Curvature.scalarOf
                    (SKEFTHawking.Curvature.ricciOf (SKEFTHawking.Curvature.constantSectionalRiemann K g)) g_inv)
                  g μ ν)
                (instHMul.hMul Λ (g μ ν)))
              0)
          (Eq Λ (instHMul.hMul 3 K))

name: SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel.bolometer_error_floor
type:
∀ (m : SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel) {kB T Tw : Real} {Vtot : (Real → Real) → Real}
  {V : Fin 2 → (Real → Real) → Real} {s hf : Real → Real} {μ₀ μ₁ σ t : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 kB →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 T →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 m.G →
        SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsUncorrelatedAt Finset.univ Vtot V →
          SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel.IsThermalFluctuationLimited (V 0) m kB T Tw →
            SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsWhiteFilteredVariance (V 1) (instHPow.hPow (m.johnsonNEP kB T) 2) Tw →
              Real.instLE.le 0 Tw →
                SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsAdmissibleFilter Tw s hf →
                  IntervalIntegrable (fun x => instHPow.hPow (s x) 2) Real.measureSpace.volume 0 Tw →
                    Real.instLT.lt 0 σ →
                      Real.instLE.le μ₀ μ₁ →
                        Eq (instHSub.hSub μ₁ μ₀)
                            (intervalIntegral (fun x => instHMul.hMul (hf x) (s x)) 0 Tw Real.measureSpace.volume) →
                          Eq σ (Vtot hf).sqrt →
                            Real.instLE.le
                              (SKEFTHawking.Detection.gaussianQ
                                (instHDiv.hDiv
                                  (SKEFTHawking.Detection.matchedBudget
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (m.phononNEP kB T) 2)
                                      (instHPow.hPow (m.johnsonNEP kB T) 2))
                                    Tw s)
                                  2))
                              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgAssignmentError (SKEFTHawking.Detection.thrErr0 μ₀ σ t)
                                (SKEFTHawking.Detection.thrErr1 μ₁ σ t))

name: SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel.phonon_floor_of_psd_ge
type:
∀ (m : SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel) {kB T Tw S₀ : Real} {Vtot : (Real → Real) → Real} {s hf : Real → Real}
  {μ₀ μ₁ σ t : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 kB →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 T →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 m.G →
        SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsWhiteFilteredVariance Vtot S₀ Tw →
          Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow (m.phononNEP kB T) 2) S₀ →
            Real.instLE.le 0 Tw →
              SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsAdmissibleFilter Tw s hf →
                IntervalIntegrable (fun x => instHPow.hPow (s x) 2) Real.measureSpace.volume 0 Tw →
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 σ →
                    Real.instLE.le μ₀ μ₁ →
                      Eq (instHSub.hSub μ₁ μ₀)
                          (intervalIntegral (fun x => instHMul.hMul (hf x) (s x)) 0 Tw Real.measureSpace.volume) →
                        Eq σ (Vtot hf).sqrt →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (SKEFTHawking.Detection.gaussianQ
                              (instHDiv.hDiv
                                (SKEFTHawking.Detection.matchedBudget (instHPow.hPow (m.phononNEP kB T) 2) Tw s) 2))
                            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgAssignmentError (SKEFTHawking.Detection.thrErr0 μ₀ σ t)
                              (SKEFTHawking.Detection.thrErr1 μ₁ σ t))

name: SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel.phonon_only_error_floor
type:
∀ (m : SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel) {kB T Tw : Real} {Vtot : (Real → Real) → Real}
  {V : Fin 2 → (Real → Real) → Real} {s hf : Real → Real} {μ₀ μ₁ σ t : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 kB →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 T →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 m.G →
        SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsUncorrelatedAt Finset.univ Vtot V →
          SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel.IsThermalFluctuationLimited (V 0) m kB T Tw →
            SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsWhiteFilteredVariance (V 1) (instHPow.hPow (m.johnsonNEP kB T) 2) Tw →
              Real.instLE.le 0 Tw →
                SKEFTHawking.Detection.IsAdmissibleFilter Tw s hf →
                  IntervalIntegrable (fun x => instHPow.hPow (s x) 2) Real.measureSpace.volume 0 Tw →
                    Real.instLT.lt 0 σ →
                      Real.instLE.le μ₀ μ₁ →
                        Eq (instHSub.hSub μ₁ μ₀)
                            (intervalIntegral (fun x => instHMul.hMul (hf x) (s x)) 0 Tw Real.measureSpace.volume) →
                          Eq σ (Vtot hf).sqrt →
                            Real.instLE.le
                              (SKEFTHawking.Detection.gaussianQ
                                (instHDiv.hDiv
                                  (SKEFTHawking.Detection.matchedBudget (instHPow.hPow (m.phononNEP kB T) 2) Tw s) 2))
                              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgAssignmentError (SKEFTHawking.Detection.thrErr0 μ₀ σ t)
                                (SKEFTHawking.Detection.thrErr1 μ₁ σ t))

type:
∀ (m : SKEFTHawking.Electrothermal.ETFModel) (Rf : Real → Real) {T : Real},
  HasDerivAt Rf m.dRdT T →
    Eq (Rf T) m.R →
      Ne m.R 0 →
        Ne m.G 0 →
          ∀ (P_sig : Real) (f : Real → Real),
            Iff (m.SolvesDrivenBalance P_sig f)
              (∀ (t : Real),
                HasDerivAt f
                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                    (instHAdd.hAdd P_sig
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub (deriv (fun τ => instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow m.V 2) (Rf τ)) T) m.G)
                        (f t)))
                    m.C)
                  t)

name: SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.balanced_commutator_bounded_of_hermitian
type:
∀ {n : Nat} (H : Matrix (Fin (instHAdd.hAdd n 2)) (Fin (instHAdd.hAdd n 2)) Complex),
  H.IsHermitian →
    Eq H.trace 0 →
      ∀ (θ : Real),
        Real.instLE.le 0 θ →
          Real.instLE.le θ 1 →
            Exists fun F =>
              Exists fun G =>
                Exists fun F_inner =>
                  Exists fun G_inner =>
                    And F.IsHermitian
                      (And G.IsHermitian
                        (And (Eq F.trace 0)
                          (And (Eq G.trace 0)
                            (And
                              (Eq
                                (instHSub.hSub (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul F G)
                                  (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul G F))
                                (instHSMul.hSMul (Complex.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal θ) Complex.I)) H))
                              (And
                                (Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm F)
                                  (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd n 2).cast 2)
                                    (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm F_inner)))
                                (Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm G)
                                  (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd n 2).cast 2)
                                    (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm G_inner))))))))

type:

  Ne i j →
    ∀ (θ : Real),
      Real.instLE.le 0 θ →
        Real.instLE.le θ 1 →
          have c := Complex.ofReal (instHDiv.hDiv θ 2).sqrt;
          And (instHSMul.hSMul c (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaYBlock i j)).IsHermitian
            (And (instHSMul.hSMul c (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaXBlock i j)).IsHermitian
              (And (Eq (instHSMul.hSMul c (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaYBlock i j)).trace 0)
                (And (Eq (instHSMul.hSMul c (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaXBlock i j)).trace 0)
                  (And
                    (Real.instLE.le
                      (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm
                        (instHSMul.hSMul c (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaYBlock i j)))
                      (instHDiv.hDiv θ 2).sqrt)
                    (And

                        (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm
                          (instHSMul.hSMul c (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaXBlock i j)))
                        (instHDiv.hDiv θ 2).sqrt)
                      (Eq
                        (instHSub.hSub
                          (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                            (instHSMul.hSMul c (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaYBlock i j))
                            (instHSMul.hSMul c (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaXBlock i j)))
                          (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                            (instHSMul.hSMul c (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaXBlock i j))
                            (instHSMul.hSMul c (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaYBlock i j))))
                        (instHSMul.hSMul (Complex.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal θ) Complex.I))
                          (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.GenericSUd.sigmaZBlock i j))))))))

            Real.instLE.le θ 1 →

                    Exists fun G_inner =>

                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd n 2).cast 2)

  Continuous φ →
    Eq (φ 0) 1 →
      (∀ (s t : Real), Eq (φ (instHAdd.hAdd s t)) (instHMul.hMul (φ s) (φ t))) →
        (Exists fun t => Ne (φ t) 1) →

                Exists fun X =>
                  Exists fun Y =>
                    Exists fun s =>
                      And
                        (SetLike.instMembership.mem (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.SU2LieAlgebra.tracelessSkewHermitian (Fin 2)) X)
                        (And (Ne X 0)
                          (And
                            (SetLike.instMembership.mem (SKEFTHawking.FKLW.SU2LieAlgebra.tracelessSkewHermitian (Fin 2))
                              Y)
                            (And (Ne s 0)
                              (And

                                  (φ s).val)
                                (And

                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul g (φ s))
                                        (Matrix.instInvSubtypeMemSubmonoidSpecialUnitaryGroup.inv g)).val)
                                  (Eq Y
                                    (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                                      (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul g.val X)
                                      (Matrix.instStar.star g.val))))))))

type:
∀ (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) Complex),
  H.IsHermitian →
    Eq H.trace 0 →
      Eq (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm H) 1 →
        ∀ (θ : Real),
          Real.instLE.le 0 θ →
            Real.instLE.le θ 1 →
              Exists fun F =>
                Exists fun G =>
                  And F.IsHermitian
                    (And G.IsHermitian
                      (And (Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm F) (instHDiv.hDiv θ 2).sqrt)
                        (And (Real.instLE.le (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm G) (instHDiv.hDiv θ 2).sqrt)
                          (Eq
                            (instHSub.hSub (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul F G)
                              (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul G F))
                            (instHSMul.hSMul (Complex.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal θ) Complex.I)) H)))))

type:
∀ (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) Complex),
  H.IsHermitian →
    Eq H.trace 0 →
      Eq (Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm H) 1 →
        ∀ (θ : Real),
          Real.instLE.le 0 θ →
            Real.instLE.le θ 1 →
              Exists fun F =>
                Exists fun G =>
                  And F.IsHermitian
                    (And G.IsHermitian
                      (And (Eq F.trace 0)

name: SKEFTHawking.FaultTolerance.steane_concatenated_failure_below_threshold
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Loc : Nat → Type u_2}
  (fail : (L : Nat) → Loc L → Set Ω) (malignant : (L : Nat) → Loc (instHAdd.hAdd L 1) → Finset (Prod (Loc L) (Loc L)))
  (ε₀ : NNReal),
  (∀ (i : Loc 0), ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (fail 0 i)) (ENNReal.ofNNReal ε₀)) →
    (∀ (L : Nat) (j : Loc (instHAdd.hAdd L 1)),
        instLENat.le (malignant L j).card SKEFTHawking.FaultTolerance.steaneMalignancyCounts.A_CNOT) →
      (∀ (L : Nat) (j : Loc (instHAdd.hAdd L 1)),
          Set.instLE.le (fail (instHAdd.hAdd L 1) j)
            (Set.iUnion fun p => Set.iUnion fun h => Set.instInter.inter (fail L p.fst) (fail L p.snd))) →
        (∀ (L : Nat) (j : Loc (instHAdd.hAdd L 1)) (p : Prod (Loc L) (Loc L)),
            SetLike.instMembership.mem (malignant L j) p →
              ENNReal.instLE.le
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instInter.inter (fail L p.fst) (fail L p.snd)))
                (instHMul.hMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (fail L p.fst))
                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (fail L p.snd)))) →
          Real.instLT.lt ε₀.toReal SKEFTHawking.FaultTolerance.AGP.steaneAGPThreshold →
            ∀ (L : Nat),
              instLENat.le 1 L →
                ∀ (i : Loc L),
                  Real.instLT.lt
                    (instHMul.hMul SKEFTHawking.FaultTolerance.steaneMalignancyCounts.A_CNOT.cast
                      (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (fail L i)).toReal)
                    1

name: SKEFTHawking.GrapheneBand.bernal_eigenvector_iff

            v)

    (Eq
      (SKEFTHawking.GrapheneBand.bernalSecular u γ (MonoidWithZeroHom.funLike.coe Complex.normSq f)
        (instHSub.hSub (instHPow.hPow E 2) (instHPow.hPow u 2)))

name: SKEFTHawking.GrapheneBand.bernal_lowBand_effectiveMass
type:
∀ (γ t a_CC ℏ p E : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 γ →
    Ne t 0 →
      Ne a_CC 0 →
        Ne ℏ 0 →
          Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (3 / 2) t) a_CC) p) 2)
              (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow γ 2) 2) →
            Eq
                (SKEFTHawking.GrapheneBand.bernalSecular 0 γ
                  (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (3 / 2) t) a_CC) p) 2)
                  (instHPow.hPow E 2))
                0 →
              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHPow.hPow E 2))
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow γ 2)
                    (instHMul.hMul 2
                      (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (3 / 2) t) a_CC) p) 2))) →
                And
                  (Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow ℏ 2) (instHPow.hPow p 2))
                        (instHMul.hMul 2 (SKEFTHawking.GrapheneBand.bernalEffectiveMass γ t a_CC ℏ)))
                      (instHDiv.hDiv
                        (instHMul.hMul 2
                          (instHPow.hPow
                            (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (3 / 2) t) a_CC) p) 2) 2))
                        (instHPow.hPow γ 3)))
                    (abs E))
                  (Real.instLE.le (abs E)
                    (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow ℏ 2) (instHPow.hPow p 2))
                      (instHMul.hMul 2 (SKEFTHawking.GrapheneBand.bernalEffectiveMass γ t a_CC ℏ))))

type:
∀ (mdr : SKEFTHawking.HawkingUniversality.ModifiedDispersion) (coeffs : SKEFTHawking.DissipativeCoeffs)
  (bg : SKEFTHawking.FluidBackground) (h : SKEFTHawking.SonicHorizon bg),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 (SKEFTHawking.HawkingUniversality.adiabaticityParam h.surfaceGravity mdr.cs mdr.cutoff) →
    And (Real.instLT.lt (SKEFTHawking.HawkingUniversality.universalEffectiveTemp mdr coeffs h).delta_disp 0)
      (And
        (Eq (abs (SKEFTHawking.HawkingUniversality.universalEffectiveTemp mdr coeffs h).delta_disp)
          (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi 6)
            (instHPow.hPow (SKEFTHawking.HawkingUniversality.adiabaticityParam h.surfaceGravity mdr.cs mdr.cutoff) 2)))
        (And (Real.instLE.le 0 (SKEFTHawking.HawkingUniversality.universalEffectiveTemp mdr coeffs h).delta_diss)
          (And
            (Iff (Eq (SKEFTHawking.HawkingUniversality.universalEffectiveTemp mdr coeffs h).delta_diss 0)
              (And (Eq coeffs.gamma_1 0) (Eq coeffs.gamma_2 0)))
            (Eq
              (abs
                (instHSub.hSub (SKEFTHawking.HawkingUniversality.universalEffectiveTemp mdr coeffs h).T_eff
                  (instHMul.hMul (SKEFTHawking.hawkingTemp h.surfaceGravity)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd 1
                      (SKEFTHawking.HawkingUniversality.universalEffectiveTemp mdr coeffs h).delta_diss))))
              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (SKEFTHawking.hawkingTemp h.surfaceGravity) (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi 6))
                (instHPow.hPow (SKEFTHawking.HawkingUniversality.adiabaticityParam h.surfaceGravity mdr.cs mdr.cutoff)
                  2))))))

name: SKEFTHawking.KummerResolutionPiece.hopf_clutch
type:
∀ {a b : Complex},
  Ne a 0 →
    Ne b 0 →
      Eq (Complex.instNorm.norm a) (Complex.instNorm.norm b) →
        ∀ (p : SKEFTHawking.KummerResolutionPiece.ResChart),
          Eq p.fst.val (instHDiv.hDiv a b) →
            Eq p.snd.val (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv b (Complex.ofReal (Complex.instNorm.norm b))) 2) →
              ∀ (hz : Eq (Complex.instNorm.norm p.fst.val) 1),
                And (Eq (SKEFTHawking.KummerResolutionPiece.clutchDisk p hz).fst.val (instHDiv.hDiv b a))
                  (Eq (SKEFTHawking.KummerResolutionPiece.clutchDisk p hz).snd.val
                    (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv a (Complex.ofReal (Complex.instNorm.norm a))) 2))

name: SKEFTHawking.KummerResolutionPiece.hopf_preimage
type:
∀ {z u : Complex},
  Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm z) 1 →
    Eq (Complex.instNorm.norm u) 1 →
      Exists fun x =>
        And (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm x.val.fst) (Complex.instNorm.norm x.val.snd))
          (And (Eq (instHDiv.hDiv x.val.fst x.val.snd) z)
            (And (Eq (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv x.val.snd (Complex.ofReal (Complex.instNorm.norm x.val.snd))) 2) u)
              (Ne x.val.snd 0)))

name: SKEFTHawking.KummerResolutionPiece.recover
type:
∀ {a b a' b' : Complex},
  Ne b 0 →
    Ne b' 0 →
      Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm a) 2) (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm b) 2)) 1 →
        Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm a') 2) (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm b') 2)) 1 →
          Eq (instHDiv.hDiv a b) (instHDiv.hDiv a' b') →
            Eq (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv b (Complex.ofReal (Complex.instNorm.norm b))) 2)
                (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv b' (Complex.ofReal (Complex.instNorm.norm b'))) 2) →
              Or (And (Eq a' a) (Eq b' b)) (And (Eq a' (Complex.instNeg.neg a)) (Eq b' (Complex.instNeg.neg b)))

type:
∀ {k : WithTop ENat} (u₁ : SKEFTHawking.DiskChartGeneric.NSphere 1) {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {T : Set E} {G : E → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)},
  ContDiffOn Real k G T →
    (∀ (p : E), Set.instMembership.mem T p → Ne (G p) 0) →
      (∀ (p : E),
          Set.instMembership.mem T p →
            Ne
              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (innerSL Real) (instInvolutiveNegElemSphereOfNat.neg u₁).val)
                (instHSMul.hSMul (Real.instInv.inv ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm (G p))) (G p)))
              1) →
        ContDiffOn Real k
          (fun p =>
            {
              fst :=
                EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (OrthonormalBasis.fromOrthogonalSpanSingleton 1 ⋯).repr
                  (stereoToFun (instInvolutiveNegElemSphereOfNat.neg u₁).val
                    (instHSMul.hSMul (Real.instInv.inv ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm (G p))) (G p))),
              snd := { ofLp := fun x => instHSub.hSub 1 ((PiLp.instNorm 2 fun x => Real).norm (G p)) } })
          T

    ContDiffOn Real k
      (fun p =>
        { fst := SKEFTHawking.DiskChartGeneric.splitLo 1 (G p),
          snd := { ofLp := fun x => instHAdd.hAdd ((G p).ofLp (Fin.last 1)) 2 } })
      T

name: SKEFTHawking.KummerResolutionPieceManifold.contDiffOn_reshapeConjTwist
type:
∀ {k : WithTop ENat} {gBase : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)}
  {gFiber :
    Prod (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (Prod (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 1)) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 1))) →
      Prod (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 1)) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 1))}
  {S : Set (Prod (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 3)) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 1)))}
  {baseSet : Set (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2))}
  {fiberSet :
    Set (Prod (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (Prod (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 1)) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 1))))},
  ContDiffOn Real k gBase baseSet →
    ContDiffOn Real k gFiber fiberSet →
      Set.MapsTo (fun m => SKEFTHawking.DiskChartGeneric.splitLo 2 m.fst) S baseSet →
        Set.MapsTo
            (fun m =>
              { fst := SKEFTHawking.DiskChartGeneric.splitLo 2 m.fst,
                snd := { fst := { ofLp := fun x => m.fst.ofLp (Fin.last 2) }, snd := m.snd } })
            S fiberSet →
          ContDiffOn Real k
            (fun m =>
              {
                fst :=
                  SKEFTHawking.DiskChartGeneric.assemble 2 (gBase (SKEFTHawking.DiskChartGeneric.splitLo 2 m.fst))
                    ((gFiber
                            { fst := SKEFTHawking.DiskChartGeneric.splitLo 2 m.fst,
                              snd := { fst := { ofLp := fun x => m.fst.ofLp (Fin.last 2) }, snd := m.snd } }).fst.ofLp
                      0),

name: SKEFTHawking.KummerSeamTransQClass.transQ_core
type:
∀ (y₀ : SKEFTHawking.KummerWeldQInterior.interiorQ.Elem) {x : SKEFTHawking.KummerPuncturedTorus.puncturedTorus.Elem}
  (h : Not (Set.instMembership.mem SKEFTHawking.KummerBoundaryChart.interiorSet x.val)),
  Eq (chartAt SKEFTHawking.HalfSpaceInteriorFlatten.HModel y₀.val)
      (SKEFTHawking.KummerBoundaryChart.qmkBoundaryChart x h) →
    ∀ (c : SKEFTHawking.KummerWeld.EIndex) (r₀ : SKEFTHawking.KummerResolutionPiece.RP3)
      {p : SKEFTHawking.HalfSpaceInteriorFlatten.FModel},
      Set.instMembership.mem
          ((SKEFTHawking.KummerK3Chart.qFamChart y₀).symm.trans (SKEFTHawking.KummerSeamChart.seamChart c r₀)).source
          p →
        Exists fun a =>
          Exists fun s =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt s.val (5 / 8))
              (And
                (Eq p
                  {
                    fst :=
                      (SKEFTHawking.KummerRP3Smooth.Φ
                            (SKEFTHawking.KummerShellChart.shellDir
                              (SKEFTHawking.KummerBoundaryChart.shellIncl
                                (SKEFTHawking.KummerBoundaryChart.chosenShell h)))).toFun'
                        (SKEFTHawking.KummerRP3ChartCoord.s3ToSphE a),
                    snd := instHSub.hSub s.val (1 / 2) })
                (And
                  (Set.instMembership.mem
                    (SKEFTHawking.KummerRP3Smooth.Φ
                        (SKEFTHawking.KummerShellChart.shellDir
                          (SKEFTHawking.KummerBoundaryChart.shellIncl
                            (SKEFTHawking.KummerBoundaryChart.chosenShell h)))).source
                    (SKEFTHawking.KummerRP3ChartCoord.s3ToSphE a))
                  (And
                    (Set.instMembership.mem
                      (SKEFTHawking.KummerRP3Smooth.rp3PinChart (SKEFTHawking.KummerSeamTransE.pinPt r₀)).source
                      (SKEFTHawking.KummerResolutionPiece.mkRP3 a))
                    (Eq ((SKEFTHawking.KummerK3Chart.qFamChart y₀).symm.toFun' p)
                      (SKEFTHawking.KummerWeld.weldMk (Sum.inl (SKEFTHawking.KummerSeamCollarQ.qCollarS3 c a s)))))))

name: SKEFTHawking.LorentzianBundle.leviCivita_unique_for_lorentzianBundle
type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4}
  [inst_4 : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_6 : IsManifold I 1 M]
  {cov cov' :
    ((x : M) → TangentSpace I x) → (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id 𝕜) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x)}
  {g :
    (x : M) →
      ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id 𝕜) (TangentSpace I x) (ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id 𝕜) (TangentSpace I x) 𝕜)},
  SKEFTHawking.LorentzianBundle.IsLorentzianBundle g →
    SKEFTHawking.LeviCivita.IsLeviCivita 𝕜 cov g →
      SKEFTHawking.LeviCivita.IsLeviCivita 𝕜 cov' g →
        Ne 2 0 →
          ∀ (x : M),
            (∀ (X Y Z : (x : M) → TangentSpace I x),
                And (MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent (fun x => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E x (X x)) x)
                  (And (MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent (fun x => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E x (Y x)) x)
                    (And (MDifferentiableAt I I.tangent (fun x => Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' E x (Z x)) x)
                      (And
                        (MDifferentiableAt I (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 𝕜)
                          (fun y => ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (g y) (Y y)) (Z y))
                          x)
                        (And
                          (MDifferentiableAt I (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 𝕜)
                            (fun y =>
                              ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (g y) (Z y)) (X y))
                            x)
                          (MDifferentiableAt I (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 𝕜)
                            (fun y =>
                              ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (g y) (X y)) (Y y))
                            x)))))) →
              ∀ (X Y : (x : M) → TangentSpace I x),
                Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (cov Y x) (X x)) (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (cov' Y x) (X x))

name: SKEFTHawking.Phase6vSubwaves8DHClose.subwaves_8_D_through_H_cumulative_closure
type:
And
  (∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a b c d e f : R),
    Eq (SKEFTHawking.MathlibAux.Matrix.pfaffianFin4 (SKEFTHawking.MathlibAux.Matrix.antisymMatrix4 a b c d e f))
      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul a f) (instHMul.hMul b e)) (instHMul.hMul c d)))
  (And (Eq SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.Theta.transpose (Matrix.neg.neg SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.Theta))
    (And
      (Eq
        (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.Theta
          SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.Theta)
        (-1))
      (And
        (Eq (SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.sewingMatrixDerivedAtGamma SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.nbReParameters 0 2)
          (-1))
        (And
          (Eq
            (SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.sewingMatrixDerivedAtGamma
              SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.elementalNbParameters 0 2)
            1)
          (And
            (∀ (sc : SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.SCParameters),
              SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.IsDIIITopologicalSuperconductor sc →
                Eq (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.diiiBdGToZ16 sc) 1)
            (And
              (∀ (sc : SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.SCParameters),
                Iff (Eq (SKEFTHawking.NbReWindingNumber.windingNumberSurrogate sc) 0) (Eq sc.centrosymmetric Bool.true))
              (∀ {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype T] (pfSignAt : T → Int),
                (∀ (k : T), Eq (pfSignAt k) 1) →
                  Eq (SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.genericFuKaneInvariant pfSignAt) 1)))))))

name: SKEFTHawking.Phase6vWave9Close.phase6v_wave9_substantive_closure
type:
And (Eq (SKEFTHawking.MathlibAux.Matrix.pfaffian 0) 1)
  (And
    (∀ (a b c d e f : Int),
      Eq (SKEFTHawking.MathlibAux.Matrix.pfaffian (SKEFTHawking.MathlibAux.Matrix.antisymMatrix4 a b c d e f))
        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul a f) (instHMul.hMul b e)) (instHMul.hMul c d)))
    (And
      (∀ (sc : SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.SCParameters),
        Eq (SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.H_BdG_NbRe sc 0 0 0)
          (SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.H_BdG_NbRe_at_gamma sc))
      (And
        (∀ (sc : SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.SCParameters),
          SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.H_BdG_NbRe_TRInvariant_at_TRIM sc)
        (And
          (Eq
            (SKEFTHawking.MathlibAux.Matrix.pfaffianFin4
              (SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.bdGSewingMatrix SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.nbReParameters 0 0 0))
            (-2))
          (And
            (∀ (H : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) Complex),
              Eq H.transpose H →
                SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.IsBdGTRSInvariant H →
                  SKEFTHawking.MathlibAux.Matrix.IsSkewSymmetric
                    (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.Theta H))
            (And
              (SKEFTHawking.MathlibAux.Matrix.IsSkewSymmetric
                (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.Theta
                  SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.H_kinetic_tau_z))
              (And
                (Eq
                  (SKEFTHawking.MathlibAux.Matrix.pfaffianFin4
                    (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.Theta
                      SKEFTHawking.BdGHamiltonianNbRe.H_kinetic_tau_z))
                  1)
                (And
                  (Eq (-2).sign
                    (SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.pfaffianSignAtTRIM SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.nbReParameters
                      SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.gamma))
                  (And
                    (Eq
                      (SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.fuKaneInvariantGeneric
                        SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.nbReParameters SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.gamma)
                      (-1))
                    (And
                      (SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.IsDIIITopologicalSuperconductor
                        SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.orthorhombicNbReParameters)
                      (And
                        (Eq
                          (SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.fuKaneInvariantGeneric
                            SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.orthorhombicNbReParameters 0)
                          (-1))
                        (And
                          (Eq
                            (SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.ima2DerivedFuKaneInvariant
                              SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.nbReIma2Structure
                              SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.orthorhombicNbReParameters)
                            (-1))
                          (And
                            (Eq
                              (SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.ima2DerivedFuKaneInvariant
                                SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.nbReIma2StructureCentrosymmetricFalsifier
                                SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.orthorhombicNbReParameters)
                              1)
                            (And
                              (Eq
                                (SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.ima2DerivedFuKaneInvariant
                                  SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.nbReIma2StructureLatticeFalsifier
                                  SKEFTHawking.TRIMParameterization.orthorhombicNbReParameters)
                                1)
                              (And
                                (Eq
                                  (SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.pfaffianSignAtGenericTRIM
                                    SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.nbReParameters SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.gamma
                                    SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.gamma)
                                  (SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.pfaffianSignAtTRIM
                                    SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.nbReParameters SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.gamma))
                                (And
                                  (Eq
                                    (SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.fuKaneInvariantGenericTRIM
                                      SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.nbReParameters SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.gamma)
                                    (-1))
                                  (And
                                    (∀ (sc : SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.SCParameters),
                                      Eq (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.nbReEtaInvariant sc)
                                        (AddMonoidHom.instFunLike.coe ZMod.toAddCircle
                                          (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.diiiBdGToZ16 sc)))
                                    (And
                                      (Ne
                                        (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.nbReEtaInvariant
                                          SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.nbReParameters)
                                        0)
                                      (And
                                        (Eq
                                          (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.nbReEtaInvariant
                                            SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.elementalNbParameters)
                                          0)
                                        (And
                                          (∀ (sc : SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.SCParameters),
                                            Eq
                                              (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.diiiBdGToZ16FromBordism
                                                sc)
                                              (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.diiiBdGToZ16 sc))
                                          (And
                                            (∀ (sc : SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.SCParameters),
                                              Eq
                                                (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.nbReEtaInvariantFromBordism
                                                  sc)
                                                (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.nbReEtaInvariant sc))
                                            (And
                                              (Eq
                                                (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.nbReBordismClass
                                                  SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.elementalNbParameters)
                                                0)
                                              (And
                                                (Ne
                                                  (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.nbReBordismClass
                                                    SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.nbReParameters)
                                                  0)
                                                (And
                                                  (∀ (sc : SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.SCParameters),
                                                    Eq
                                                      (instHSMul.hSMul 16
                                                        (SKEFTHawking.CrossBridges.NbReDIIIToPinPlusZ16.nbReBordismClass
                                                          sc))
                                                      0)
                                                  (And
                                                    (SKEFTHawking.NbReWindingNumber.IsSatoFujimotoIntegerWinding
                                                      SKEFTHawking.NbReWindingNumber.windingNumberSurrogate)
                                                    (∀ (f : SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.SCParameters → Int),
                                                      SKEFTHawking.NbReWindingNumber.IsSatoFujimotoIntegerWinding f →
                                                        ∀ (sc : SKEFTHawking.NbReTripletSPT.SCParameters),
                                                          Eq (instHMod.hMod (f sc) 2)
                                                            (instHMod.hMod
                                                              (SKEFTHawking.NbReWindingNumber.windingNumberSurrogate sc)
                                                              2)))))))))))))))))))))))))))

          Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 1) (a h)) →
        And
          (Real.instLE.le
            (abs
              (instHSub.hSub
                (instHDiv.hDiv
                  (instHSub.hSub 1
                    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveMapPerturbation.outputDistance (Fin d) Unit o T_A T_B

                  (instHSub.hSub 1
                    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveMapPerturbation.outputDistance (Fin d) Unit o T_A T_B

                        (SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.DiagonalLindblad.density R.w))))

                  (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.traceDist σB

                    (fun h =>
                      SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.run (Fin d) Unit o T_A h
                        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveGibbsReadout.preparedJoint R γ τ σA))

                        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveGibbsReadout.preparedJoint R γ τ σB))
                    F)
                  (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.readoutError
                    (fun h =>
                      SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.run (Fin d) Unit o T_A h
                        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.GibbsMultilevelReflection.joint
                          (SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.DiagonalLindblad.density R.w)))

                    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.traceDist σB
                      (SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.DiagonalLindblad.density R.w))))
                2))
            (And

                      (fun h =>

                      (fun h =>

                          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.GibbsMultilevelReflection.joint
                            (SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.DiagonalLindblad.density R.w)))
                      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.optimalReadout ⋯ ⋯))
                    (instHDiv.hDiv
                      (instHSub.hSub 1
                        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveMapPerturbation.outputDistance (Fin d) Unit o T_A T_B
                          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveGibbsReadout.preparedJoint R γ τ σA)
                          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveGibbsReadout.preparedJoint R γ τ σB)))
                      2)))
                (instHDiv.hDiv
                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                    (instHMul.hMul (Real.exp (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg γ) τ))
                      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.traceDist σA

                      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.traceDist σB
                        (SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.DiagonalLindblad.density R.w))))
                  2))
              (Real.instLE.le
                (abs
                  (instHSub.hSub
                    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.historyError
                      (fun h =>
                        SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.run (Fin d) Unit o T_A h
                          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveGibbsReadout.preparedJoint R γ τ σA))

                          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveGibbsReadout.preparedJoint R γ τ σB))

                    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.historyError
                      (fun h =>

                          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.GibbsMultilevelReflection.joint

                      (fun h =>

                          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.GibbsMultilevelReflection.joint
                            (SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.DiagonalLindblad.density R.w)))
                      a)))

                    (instHMul.hMul (Real.exp (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg γ) τ))
                      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.traceDist σA

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutRobustness.orthogonal_depth_zero_physical
type:
have A := fun h =>
  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.run (Fin 2) Unit 2
    SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.Tree.done h
    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.qubitJoint
      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteMemoryProcess.basisState 1));
have B := fun h =>
  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.run (Fin 2) Unit 2
    SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.Tree.done h
    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.qubitJoint
      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteMemoryProcess.basisState 0));
And
  (Eq
    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutRobustness.instrumentError A B
      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.optimalReadout ⋯ ⋯))
    0)
  (And
    (∀ (h : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.History 2 0) (a : Fin 2),
      Real.instLE.le 0
        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.readoutTable
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.optimalReadout ⋯ ⋯) A h a))
    (Eq
      (Finset.univ.sum fun h =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
          SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.readoutTable
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.optimalReadout ⋯ ⋯) A h a)
      1))

      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteMemoryProcess.basisState 0)
      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteMemoryProcess.basisState 0)))
  (And
    (Ne
      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.krausMap
        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutRobustness.wrapStep
            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.flipPrepare
            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveMixtureSurvival.identityKraus
            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveMixtureSurvival.identityKraus_normalized
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInstrument.prepare 1)
            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutRobustness.positiveNoise).evolution
        (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => instHMul.hMul x1 x2)
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteMemoryProcess.basisState 0)
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteMemoryProcess.basisState 0)))
      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.krausMap
        SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.flipPrepare.evolution
        (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => instHMul.hMul x1 x2)
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteMemoryProcess.basisState 0)
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteMemoryProcess.basisState 0))))
    (Ne
      (((SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutRobustness.wrapStep
                  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.flipPrepare
                  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveMixtureSurvival.identityKraus
                  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveMixtureSurvival.identityKraus_normalized
                  (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInstrument.prepare 1)
                  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutRobustness.positiveNoise).instrument.lift
            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteMemoryProcess.Qubit).branch
        0
        (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => instHMul.hMul x1 x2)

  (And

      (And

              (List.cons SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.dephasingLogTwoSlice List.nil))
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.input

            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.input
