∀ (s : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.Schedule)
  {X : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.MatQ},
  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.IsDensityOperator X →
    ∀ (h : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.Hist),
      Eq (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.resetFamily s X h)

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.reset_laws
type:
∀ (s : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.Schedule),
  And
    (∀ (h : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.Hist) (a : Fin 2),
      Real.instLE.le 0
        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.readoutTable
          SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.decisionReadout
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.resetFamily s
            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.qubitX)
          h a))
    (And
      (Eq
        (Finset.univ.sum fun h =>
          Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.readoutTable
              SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.decisionReadout
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.resetFamily s
                SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.qubitX)
              h a)
        1)
      (And
        (∀ (h : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.Hist) (a : Fin 2),
          Real.instLE.le 0
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.readoutTable
              SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.decisionReadout
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.resetFamily s
                SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.qubitY)
              h a))
        (Eq
          (Finset.univ.sum fun h =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
              SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.readoutTable
                SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.decisionReadout
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialCoherentReadout.resetFamily s
                  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.qubitY)
                h a)
          1)))

                  h a)

    (SKEFTHawking.OpenSystems.lindbladGenerator 0
      (SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.GibbsBlockRelaxation.jumps

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.generator_analyticState
type:
∀ (γ η t : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 γ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 η →
      ∀ (X : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.MatQ),
        Eq
          (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.generator γ η)
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.analyticState γ η t X))
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHSMul.hSMul
              (Complex.ofReal (instHMul.hMul (Real.exp (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg γ) t)) (Real.instNeg.neg γ)))
              (instHSub.hSub (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialReflectionDynamics.diagonalPart X)
                (instHSMul.hSMul (Matrix.trace X) SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialPauliReflection.rhoN)))
            (instHSMul.hSMul
              (Complex.ofReal
                (instHMul.hMul (Real.exp (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg (instHAdd.hAdd γ η)) t))
                  (Real.instNeg.neg (instHAdd.hAdd γ η))))
              (instHSub.hSub X (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialReflectionDynamics.diagonalPart X))))

  (hXA : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.IsDensityOperator X_A) (hXB : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.IsDensityOperator X_B),

        (∀ (h : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.History 3 n),

          ∀ (a : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.History 3 n → Real),
            (∀ (h : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.History 3 n),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 1) (a h)) →
              have βA :=
                Real.instMin.min 1
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.traceDist X_A Y_A)
                    (List.map (fun r => instHAdd.hAdd r.p r.q) rsA).sum);
              have βB :=
                Real.instMin.min 1
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.traceDist X_B Y_B)
                    (List.map (fun r => instHAdd.hAdd r.p r.q) rsB).sum);
              And
                (Real.instLE.le
                  (abs
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHDiv.hDiv
                        (instHSub.hSub 1
                          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveMapPerturbation.outputDistance
                            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.Q Unit 3
                            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.ideal B PA)
                            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.ideal B PB) X_A X_B))
                        2)
                      (instHDiv.hDiv
                        (instHSub.hSub 1
                          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveMapPerturbation.outputDistance
                            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.Q Unit 3
                            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.noisy B PA rsA lenA)
                            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.noisy B PB rsB lenB) Y_A Y_B))
                        2)))
                  (instHDiv.hDiv (instHAdd.hAdd βA βB) 2))
                (And
                  (Real.instLE.le
                    (abs
                      (instHSub.hSub
                        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.readoutError
                          (fun h =>
                            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.run
                              SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.Q Unit 3
                              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.ideal B PA) h X_A)
                          (fun h =>
                            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.run
                              SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.Q Unit 3
                              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.ideal B PB) h X_B)
                          F)
                        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.readoutError
                          (fun h =>
                            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.run
                              SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.Q Unit 3
                              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.noisy B PA rsA lenA) h Y_A)
                          (fun h =>
                            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.run
                              SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.Q Unit 3
                              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.noisy B PB rsB lenB) h Y_B)
                          F)))
                    (instHDiv.hDiv (instHAdd.hAdd βA βB) 2))
                  (And
                    (Real.instLE.le
                      (abs
                        (instHSub.hSub
                          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutRobustness.instrumentError
                            (fun h =>
                              SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteInterventionProcess.run
                                SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.Q Unit 3
                                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelAdaptiveReadout.noisy B PA rsA lenA) h Y_A)

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelCoherentReadout.randomized_isLeast
type:
∀ (b ℏ γ t φ : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 γ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 t →
      ∀ {r : Real},
        Real.instLE.le 0 r →
          Real.instLE.le r 1 →
            IsLeast
              (setOf fun x =>
                Exists fun s =>
                  And
                    (∀ (h : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelCoherentReadout.Hist),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 1) (s h))
                    (Eq
                      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.historyError
                        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelCoherentReadout.family b ℏ γ t r φ Bool.false)
                        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelCoherentReadout.family b ℏ γ t r φ Bool.true) s)
                      x))
              (instHDiv.hDiv
                (instHSub.hSub 1
                  (instHMul.hMul (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelThermalPhase.retention r γ t)
                    (abs
                      (Real.cos
                        (instHSub.hSub (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelThermalPhase.theta b ℏ t) φ)))))
                2)

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.thermal_observable_action
type:
∀ (b ℏ γ t : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 γ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 t →
      ∀ (A : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.MatJoint),
        Eq
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.liftObservable
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelThermalPhase.channelKraus b ℏ γ t) A)
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHSMul.hSMul (Complex.ofReal (Real.exp (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg γ) t)))
              (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                  (Matrix.conjTranspose
                    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.phaseUnitary b ℏ t))
                  A)
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.phaseUnitary b ℏ t)))
            (instHSMul.hSMul (Complex.ofReal (instHSub.hSub 1 (Real.exp (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg γ) t))))
              (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => instHMul.hMul x1 x2)
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.weightedPartial A) 1)))

      ∀ {A B : H → SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.MatJoint},
        SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.IsBranchFamily A →
          SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.IsBranchFamily B →
            (∀ (h : H),

                  (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.ptrace2 (B h))) →
              IsLeast
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.PhysicalErrors
                  (fun h => SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.thermal b ℏ γ t (A h)) fun h =>
                  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.thermal b ℏ γ t (B h))
                (instHDiv.hDiv

                    (instHMul.hMul (Real.exp (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg γ) t))
                      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.branchDistance A B)))
                  2)

            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutRobustness.instrumentError

                  (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelMemoryReadout.memoryFamily b ℏ γ t r hγ ht Bool.false h))

  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => instHMul.hMul x1 x2)
    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.GibbsMultilevelReflection.projector 0)
    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.GibbsMultilevelReflection.projector 0);
And (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.IsDensityOperator X)
  (And
    (Eq
      ((SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelMemoryReadout.sequentialReadout 0 0 Bool.false
            { fst := 2, snd := { fst := 0, snd := Unit.unit } }).weight
        0 X)
      1)
    (And
      (Eq
        ((SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelMemoryReadout.groupedReadout 0 0 Bool.false
              { fst := 2, snd := { fst := 0, snd := Unit.unit } }).weight
          0 X)
        1)
      (And
        (Ne
          ((SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelMemoryReadout.sequentialReadout 0 0 Bool.false
                { fst := 2, snd := { fst := 0, snd := Unit.unit } }).branch
            0 X)
          ((SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelMemoryReadout.groupedReadout 0 0 Bool.false
                { fst := 2, snd := { fst := 0, snd := Unit.unit } }).branch
            0 X))
        (Ne
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelEnvironmentLift.swap
            ((SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelMemoryReadout.sequentialReadout 0 0 Bool.false
                  { fst := 2, snd := { fst := 0, snd := Unit.unit } }).branch
              0 X))
          ((SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteThreeLevelMemoryReadout.groupedReadout 0 0 Bool.false
                { fst := 2, snd := { fst := 0, snd := Unit.unit } }).branch
            0 X)))))

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork.IsFeasibleFlow
type: {V : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype V] → SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork V → (V → V → Real) → Prop

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork.IsFeasibleFlow.eq_1
type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype V] (N : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork V) (f : V → V → Real),
  Eq (N.IsFeasibleFlow f)
    (And (∀ (u v : V), Real.instLE.le 0 (f u v))
      (And (∀ (u v : V), Real.instLE.le (f u v) (N.cap u v))
        (∀ (u : V),
          Ne u N.source → Ne u N.sink → Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun w => f u w) (Finset.univ.sum fun w => f w u))))

  Eq (N.IsResidualEdge f a b) (Or (Real.instLT.lt (f a b) (N.cap a b)) (Real.instLT.lt 0 (f b a)))

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork.aug_core
type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {N : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork V} {f : V → V → Real},
  N.IsFeasibleFlow f →
    ∀ (l : List V) (c : V) (g : V → V → Real) (δ : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 δ →
        (∀ (a b : V), And (Real.instLE.le 0 (g a b)) (Real.instLE.le (g a b) (N.cap a b))) →
          Eq (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork.exc g c)
              (instHAdd.hAdd (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork.exc f c) δ) →
            Eq (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork.exc g N.source)
                (instHSub.hSub (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork.exc f N.source) δ) →
              (∀ (x : V),
                  Ne x N.source →
                    Ne x c →
                      Eq (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork.exc g x)
                        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FlowNetwork.exc f x)) →
                List.IsChain (N.IsResidualEdge f) (List.cons c l) →
                  Eq ((List.cons c l).getLast ⋯) N.sink →
                    (List.cons c l).Nodup →
                      Not (List.instMembership.mem (List.cons c l) N.source) →
                        (∀ (e : V),
                            List.instMembership.mem l e → ∀ (y : V), And (Eq (g e y) (f e y)) (Eq (g y e) (f y e))) →
                          Exists fun g' => And (N.IsFeasibleFlow g') (Real.instLT.lt (N.flowValue f) (N.flowValue g'))

                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyCenteredVector p rs 0)))

        (Real.instLT.lt
          (instHPow.hPow
            ((SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.instNormedAddCommGroupSpace
                  (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.kernel p rs s) ⋯).norm
              (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.toInserted p rs s)
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyCenteredVector p rs 0)))

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.inserted_mode_physical_values
type:
∀ (p : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.Gap)
  (rs : List SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.Gap)
  (s : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.Schedule),
  And
    (Eq
      (instHPow.hPow
        ((SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.instNormedAddCommGroupSpace
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.kernel p rs s) ⋯).norm
          (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.toInserted p rs s)
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyCenteredVector p rs 2)))
        2)
      (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul 576 (instHPow.hPow p.value 2)) 625)
        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.diagonalDistance s)))
    (And
      (Eq
        (instHPow.hPow
          ((SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.instNormedAddCommGroupSpace
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.kernel p rs s) ⋯).norm
            (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.toInserted p rs s)
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyCenteredVector p rs 0)))
          2)
        (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul 24 (instHPow.hPow p.value 2)) 25)
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.beta s)))
      (And
        (Eq
          (instHPow.hPow
            ((SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.instNormedAddCommGroupSpace
                  (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.kernel p rs s) ⋯).norm
              (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.toInserted p rs s)
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyCenteredVector p rs 1)))
            2)
          (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul 24 (instHPow.hPow p.value 2)) 25)
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.beta s)))
        (Eq
          (instHPow.hPow
            ((SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.instNormedAddCommGroupSpace
                  (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.kernel p rs s) ⋯).norm
              (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.toInserted p rs s)
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyComplexVector p rs)))
            2)
          (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul 48 (instHPow.hPow p.value 2)) 25)
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.beta s)))))

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.primitive_negative_generator
type:
∀ (p : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.Gap)
  (rs : List SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.Gap)
  (h : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.Slice)
  (z : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.HistorySpace p rs)
  (X : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialPauliReflection.Mat2),
  Eq
    (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyCoordinates p rs) z)
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
          (SKEFTHawking.OpenSystems.lindbladGenerator 0
            (SKEFTHawking.FinitePositiveKernel.GibbsBlockRelaxation.jumps
              SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialReflectionDynamics.signature
              SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialPauliReflection.weights h.gamma h.eta))
          X)).trace
    (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyCoordinates p rs)
          (SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass.neg
            (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyGenerator p rs h.gamma h.eta) z)))
        X).trace

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.reflection_reset
type:
∀ (p : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.Gap)
  (rs : List SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.Gap)
  (s : SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.Schedule),
  Eq p.value 0 →
    And (Eq (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyScalarProjection p rs) 1)
      (And (Eq (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyDiagonalProjection p rs) 1)
        (And (Eq (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.scheduleTransfer p rs s) 1)
          (And
            (Eq
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyGenerator p rs
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.G s)
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.D s))
              0)
            (And
              (Eq
                (ContinuousLinearMap.hasOpNorm.norm
                  (instHSub.hSub (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.scheduleTransfer p rs s)
                    (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyScalarProjection p rs)))
                0)
              (And
                (∀ (a : Fin 3),
                  Eq (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyCenteredVector p rs a) 0)
                (Eq (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyComplexVector p rs) 0))))))

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.reset_logTwo_witness
type:
∀ (rs : List SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.Gap),
  And
    (Real.instLT.lt 0
      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.G
        (List.cons SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.logTwoSlice List.nil)))
    (And
      (Real.instLT.lt 0
        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.D
          (List.cons SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.logTwoSlice List.nil)))
      (And
        (Eq
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.scheduleTransfer
            SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.zeroGap rs
            (List.cons SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.logTwoSlice List.nil))
          1)
        (And
          (Eq
            (ContinuousLinearMap.hasOpNorm.norm
              (instHSub.hSub
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialScheduleTransfer.scheduleTransfer
                  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.zeroGap rs
                  (List.cons SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.logTwoSlice List.nil))
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialHistoryConsistency.historyScalarProjection
                  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.zeroGap rs)))
            0)
          (And
            (Eq
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.diagonalDistance
                (List.cons SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.logTwoSlice List.nil))
              (1 / 2))
            (And
              (Eq
                (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.coherentDistance
                  (List.cons SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.logTwoSlice List.nil))
                (instHDiv.hDiv SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.invSqrtTwo 4))
              (And
                (Eq
                  (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.diagonalError
                    (List.cons SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.logTwoSlice List.nil))
                  (1 / 4))
                (Eq
                  (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.NontracialOperationalCompatibility.coherentError
                    (List.cons SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteNontracialSchedule.logTwoSlice List.nil))
                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                    (instHSub.hSub 1
                      (instHDiv.hDiv SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.FiniteAdaptiveReadoutDiscrimination.invSqrtTwo 4))
                    2))))))))

type: {d m : Nat} → (Fin m → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex) → Real

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgGateFidelity_coherenceChannel
type:
∀ {t T1 T2 : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 t →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 T1 →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 T2 →
        Eq (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgGateFidelity (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.coherenceChannel t T1 T2))
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd (1 / 2) (instHMul.hMul (1 / 6) (Real.exp (instHDiv.hDiv (Real.instNeg.neg t) T1))))
            (instHMul.hMul (1 / 3)
              (Real.exp
                (instHSub.hSub (instHDiv.hDiv (Real.instNeg.neg t) (instHMul.hMul 2 T1)) (instHDiv.hDiv t T2)))))

          Real.instLE.le t t' →
            Real.instLE.le
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgGateFidelity (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.coherenceChannel t' T1 T2))
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgGateFidelity (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.coherenceChannel t T1 T2))

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgGateFidelity_diamondDist_bound
type:
∀ {m n : Nat} [NeZero n] {K : Fin (instHAdd.hAdd m 1) → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Complex},
  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.IsKrausChannel K →
    Real.instLE.le
      (instHSub.hSub 1
        (instHDiv.hDiv
            (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd n.cast 1) (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgGateFidelity K)) 1)
            n.cast).sqrt)
      (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.diamondDist K (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.idKrausPad m n))

name: SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgGateFidelity_diamondDist_two_sided
type:
∀ {m n : Nat} [NeZero n] {K : Fin (instHAdd.hAdd m 1) → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Complex},
  SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.IsKrausChannel K →
    And
      (Real.instLE.le
        (instHSub.hSub 1
          (instHDiv.hDiv
              (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd n.cast 1) (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgGateFidelity K)) 1)
              n.cast).sqrt)
        (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.traceDist
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.krausMap (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.tensorKraus K)
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.maxEntangled n))
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.maxEntangled n)))
      (And
        (Real.instLE.le
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.traceDist
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.krausMap (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.tensorKraus K)
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.maxEntangled n))
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.maxEntangled n))
          (instHSub.hSub 1
              (instHDiv.hDiv
                (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd n.cast 1) (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.avgGateFidelity K))
                  1)
                n.cast)).sqrt)
        (Real.instLE.le
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.traceDist
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.krausMap (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.tensorKraus K)
              (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.maxEntangled n))
            (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.maxEntangled n))
          (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.diamondDist K (SKEFTHawking.QuantumNetwork.idKrausPad m n))))

name: SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.fdr_from_kms
type:
∀ (coeffs : SKEFTHawking.DissipativeCoeffs) (beta : Real),
  have action := SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.firstOrderDissipativeAction coeffs beta;
  ∀ (f : SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.SKFields),
    Eq (action.lagrangian f).snd
      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv coeffs.gamma_1 beta) (instHPow.hPow f.psi_a 2))
        (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv coeffs.gamma_2 beta) (instHPow.hPow f.dt_psi_a 2)))

name: SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.fdr_from_kms_gamma1
type:
∀ (coeffs : SKEFTHawking.DissipativeCoeffs) (beta : Real),
  have action := SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.firstOrderDissipativeAction coeffs beta;
  Eq
    (action.lagrangian
        { psi_r := 0, psi_a := 1, dt_psi_r := 0, dx_psi_r := 0, dt_psi_a := 0, dx_psi_a := 0, dtt_psi_r := 0,
          dtx_psi_r := 0, dxx_psi_r := 0 }).snd
    (instHDiv.hDiv coeffs.gamma_1 beta)

name: SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.fdr_from_kms_gamma2
type:
∀ (coeffs : SKEFTHawking.DissipativeCoeffs) (beta : Real),
  have action := SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.firstOrderDissipativeAction coeffs beta;

          dtx_psi_r := 0, dxx_psi_r := 0 }).snd

name: SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.firstOrderAction
type: SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.FirstOrderCoeffs → SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.SKAction

name: SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.firstOrderAction.eq_1
type:
∀ (c : SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.FirstOrderCoeffs),
  Eq (SKEFTHawking.SKDoubling.firstOrderAction c)
    {
      lagrangian := fun f =>
        have re :=
          instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (instHAdd.hAdd
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r1 f.psi_a) f.dtt_psi_r)
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r2 f.psi_a) f.dxx_psi_r))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r3 f.psi_a) f.dtx_psi_r))
                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r4 f.psi_a) f.dt_psi_r))
              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r5 f.psi_a) f.dx_psi_r))
            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r6 f.psi_a) f.psi_r);
        have im :=
          instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul c.i1 (instHPow.hPow f.psi_a 2))
              (instHMul.hMul c.i2 (instHPow.hPow f.dt_psi_a 2)))
            (instHMul.hMul c.i3 (instHPow.hPow f.dx_psi_a 2));
        { fst := re, snd := im } }

∀ (s : SKEFTHawking.ScalarRungInterpretation.ScalarChannel) (g g' : Real) (hg : Real.instLT.lt 0 g)
  (hg' : Real.instLE.le 0 g'),
  have e :=
    { g := g, g' := g', v := SKEFTHawking.ScalarRungInterpretation.mexicanHatVev s, g_pos := hg, g'_nonneg := hg',
      v_pos := ⋯ };
  And
    (Eq (SKEFTHawking.ScalarRungInterpretation.wMass e)
      (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul g (SKEFTHawking.ScalarRungInterpretation.mexicanHatVev s)) 2))
    (And
      (Eq (SKEFTHawking.ScalarRungInterpretation.zMass e)
        (instHDiv.hDiv
          (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow g 2) (instHPow.hPow g' 2)).sqrt
            (SKEFTHawking.ScalarRungInterpretation.mexicanHatVev s))
          2))
      (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 (SKEFTHawking.ScalarRungInterpretation.wMass e))
        (Real.instLE.le (SKEFTHawking.ScalarRungInterpretation.wMass e)
          (SKEFTHawking.ScalarRungInterpretation.zMass e))))

name: SKEFTHawking.SecondOrderSK.fullSecondOrderAction.eq_1
type:
∀ (c : SKEFTHawking.SecondOrderSK.FullSecondOrderCoeffs),
  Eq (SKEFTHawking.SecondOrderSK.fullSecondOrderAction c)
    {
      lagrangian := fun f =>
        have re :=
          instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (instHAdd.hAdd
                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r1 f.psi_a) f.dtt_psi_r)
                            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r2 f.psi_a) f.dxx_psi_r))
                          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r3 f.psi_a) f.dtx_psi_r))
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r4 f.psi_a) f.dt_psi_r))
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r5 f.psi_a) f.dx_psi_r))
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.r6 f.psi_a) f.psi_r))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.s1 f.psi_a) f.dxxx_psi_r))
                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.s2 f.psi_a) f.dtxx_psi_r))
              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.s3 f.psi_a) f.dttx_psi_r))
            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.s4 f.psi_a) f.dttt_psi_r);
        have im :=
          instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul c.i1 (instHPow.hPow f.psi_a 2))
                (instHMul.hMul c.i2 (instHPow.hPow f.dt_psi_a 2)))
              (instHMul.hMul c.i3 (instHPow.hPow f.dx_psi_a 2)))
            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul c.j_tx f.dt_psi_a) f.dx_psi_a);
        { fst := re, snd := im } }

                (instHAdd.hAdd N 1)).ker

name: SKEFTHawking.bad_prime_R_certificate
type:
∀ {p : Nat} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {m : Nat},
  instLTNat.lt 0 m →
    ∀ {c0 c1 : Int},
      Ne c0 0 →
        Ne c1 0 →
          ∀ (Rq : Fin m → Padic p),
            (∀ (i : Fin m), Ne (Rq i) 0) →
              (Exists fun x =>
                  And (Ne x 0)
                    (Eq
                      (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                        instHMul.hMul (Fin.cons c0.cast (Fin.cons c1.cast Rq) i) (instHPow.hPow (x i) 2))
                      0)) →
                Exists fun n0 =>
                  Exists fun n1 =>
                    Exists fun N =>
                      ∀ (X0 X1 : Int),
                        Int.instDvd.dvd (instHPow.hPow p.cast N) (instHSub.hSub X0 n0) →
                          Int.instDvd.dvd (instHPow.hPow p.cast N) (instHSub.hSub X1 n1) →
                            And
                              (Ne
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul c0 (instHPow.hPow X0 2))
                                  (instHMul.hMul c1 (instHPow.hPow X1 2)))
                                0)
                              (Exists fun y =>
                                Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHMul.hMul (Rq i) (instHPow.hPow (y i) 2))
                                  ((instNegPadic p).neg
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul c0 (instHPow.hPow X0 2))
                                        (instHMul.hMul c1 (instHPow.hPow X1 2))).cast))

                  Ne t 0 →
                    Int.instDvd.dvd (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (padicValInt 2 m) 3)) (instHSub.hSub t m) →

type:
∀ {d : Nat} (F : (Fin d → Real) → Complex) (n : Fin d → Int),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun x =>
        instHMul.hMul
          (Complex.exp
            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I)
              (Complex.ofReal (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg (n i).cast) (x i)))))
          (F x))
      MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.pi.volume →
    (∀
        (γ :
          Subtype fun x =>
            SetLike.instMembership.mem
              (Submodule.span Int (Set.range (Module.Basis.instFunLike.coe (Pi.basisFun Real (Fin d))))) x),
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun x =>
            instHMul.hMul
              (Complex.exp
                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I)
                  (Complex.ofReal (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg (n i).cast) (x i)))))
              (F (instHAdd.hAdd x γ.val)))
          (MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.pi.volume.restrict (ZSpan.fundamentalDomain (Pi.basisFun Real (Fin d))))) →
      Ne
          (tsum fun γ =>
            MeasureTheory.lintegral
              (MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.pi.volume.restrict (ZSpan.fundamentalDomain (Pi.basisFun Real (Fin d))))
              fun x =>
              SeminormedAddGroup.toContinuousENorm.enorm
                (instHMul.hMul
                  (Complex.exp
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I)
                      (Complex.ofReal (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg (n i).cast) (x i)))))
                  (F (instHAdd.hAdd x γ.val))))
          ENNReal.instTop.top →
        Eq
          (MeasureTheory.integral
            (MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.pi.volume.restrict (ZSpan.fundamentalDomain (Pi.basisFun Real (Fin d))))
            fun x =>
            instHMul.hMul
              (Complex.exp
                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I)
                  (Complex.ofReal (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg (n i).cast) (x i)))))

                  { fst := α, snd := { fst := β, snd := { fst := γ, snd := δ } } }

∀ {n : Nat} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Int),

      ∀ (v : Fin n → Int),
        SKEFTHawking.IsPrimitiveVec v →
          Eq (dotProduct v (M.mulVec v)) 0 →
            SKEFTHawking.IsUnimodular M →
              Exists fun w' =>
                And (Eq (dotProduct v (M.mulVec v)) 0)
                  (And (Eq (dotProduct v (M.mulVec w')) 1) (Eq (dotProduct w' (M.mulVec w')) 0))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_int_coprime_residues

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_isometry_map_of_perp_hyp
type:
∀ {n : Nat} (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Int),
  Eq G.transpose G →
    SKEFTHawking.IsUnimodular G →
      ∀ (e f w w' k : Fin n → Int) (m : Int),
        Eq (dotProduct e (G.mulVec e)) 0 →
          Eq (dotProduct f (G.mulVec f)) 0 →
            Eq (dotProduct e (G.mulVec f)) 1 →
              Eq (dotProduct w (G.mulVec w)) 1 →
                Eq (dotProduct w' (G.mulVec w')) 1 →
                  Eq (dotProduct e (G.mulVec w)) 0 →
                    Eq (dotProduct f (G.mulVec w)) 0 →
                      Eq (dotProduct e (G.mulVec w')) 0 →
                        Eq (dotProduct f (G.mulVec w')) 0 →
                          Eq (instHSub.hSub w w') (instHSMul.hSMul 2 k) →
                            Eq (dotProduct k (G.mulVec k)) (instHMul.hMul 2 m) →
                              Exists fun T =>
                                And (IsUnit T.det)
                                  (And
                                    (Eq
                                      (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                                        (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul T.transpose G) T)
                                      G)
                                    (Eq (T.mulVec w) w'))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_ne_zero_isotropic_congr

  Q₁.Equivalent Q₂ →

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_padicInt_binary_rep

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_padicInt_diag_ternary_of_padic
type:

  (Exists fun x =>

          And (Not (And (Eq x 0) (And (Eq y 0) (Eq z 0))))
            (Eq
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul a.val (instHPow.hPow x 2)) (instHMul.hMul b.val (instHPow.hPow y 2)))
                (instHMul.hMul c.val (instHPow.hPow z 2)))
              0)) →
    Exists fun X =>
      Exists fun Y =>
        Exists fun Z =>
          And (Not (And (Eq X 0) (And (Eq Y 0) (Eq Z 0))))
            (Eq
              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul a (instHPow.hPow X 2)) (instHMul.hMul b (instHPow.hPow Y 2)))
                (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow Z 2)))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_padicInt_ternary_of_padic
type:

        Exists fun z =>
          And (Not (And (Eq x 0) (And (Eq y 0) (Eq z 0))))
            (Eq (instHPow.hPow z 2)
              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul u.val (instHPow.hPow x 2))
                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul p.cast v.val) (instHPow.hPow y 2))))) →
    Exists fun X =>
      Exists fun Y =>
        Exists fun Z =>
          And (Not (And (Eq X 0) (And (Eq Y 0) (Eq Z 0))))
            (Eq (instHPow.hPow Z 2)
              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul u (instHPow.hPow X 2))
                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul p.cast v) (instHPow.hPow Y 2))))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_padicInt_unit_of_norm_one

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_peel_pair
type:
∀ {n : Nat},

    ∀ (c : Fin n → Real),
      (∀ (k : Fin n), Ne (c k) 0) →
        (Exists fun p => Real.instLT.lt 0 (c p)) →
          (Exists fun q => Real.instLT.lt (c q) 0) →
            Exists fun i =>
              Exists fun j =>
                And (Ne i j)
                  (And (Exists fun k => And (Ne k i) (And (Ne k j) (Real.instLT.lt 0 (c k))))
                    (Exists fun l => And (Ne l i) (And (Ne l j) (Real.instLT.lt (c l) 0))))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_perm_of_pm_sum_eq

    (∀ (i : Fin n), Or (Eq (d' i) 1) (Eq (d' i) (-1))) →
      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => d i) (Finset.univ.sum fun i => d' i) →
        Exists fun σ => ∀ (i : Fin n), Eq (d (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe σ i)) (d' i)

            (∀ (p : Nat), Nat.Prime p → Nat.instDvd.dvd p m.natAbs → IsSquare r.val.cast) →

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_prime_prime_pow_residues
type:
∀ (N : Nat) {S : List Nat},

      ∀ (e : Nat → Nat),
        (∀ (p : Nat), List.instMembership.mem S p → instLTNat.lt 0 (e p)) →
          ∀ (r : Nat → Nat),
            (∀ (p : Nat), List.instMembership.mem S p → Not (Nat.instDvd.dvd p (r p))) →

                And (Nat.Prime q)

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_primitive_diag_ternary
type:
∀ {p : Nat} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b c : PadicInt p},
  (Exists fun x =>
      Exists fun y =>
        Exists fun z =>
          And (Not (And (Eq x 0) (And (Eq y 0) (Eq z 0))))
            (Eq
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul a.val (instHPow.hPow x 2)) (instHMul.hMul b.val (instHPow.hPow y 2)))
                (instHMul.hMul c.val (instHPow.hPow z 2)))
              0)) →
    Exists fun X =>
      Exists fun Y =>
        Exists fun Z =>
          And (Or (IsUnit X) (Or (IsUnit Y) (IsUnit Z)))
            (Eq
              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul a (instHPow.hPow X 2)) (instHMul.hMul b (instHPow.hPow Y 2)))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_residue_smul_congr

              And (Not (Int.instDvd.dvd p.cast rval.cast))
                (Int.instDvd.dvd (instHPow.hPow p.cast (instHAdd.hAdd (padicValInt p m) δ))
                  (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul SP rval.cast) m))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_sign_for_real_common
type:
∀ {a b c d : Real},
  (Exists fun t =>
      And (Ne t 0)
        (And (Or (Real.instLE.le 0 (instHMul.hMul a t)) (Real.instLE.le 0 (instHMul.hMul b t)))
          (Or (Real.instLE.le 0 (instHMul.hMul c t)) (Real.instLE.le 0 (instHMul.hMul d t))))) →
    Exists fun ε =>
      And (Or (Eq ε 1) (Eq ε (-1)))
        (And (Or (Real.instLE.le 0 (instHMul.hMul a ε)) (Real.instLE.le 0 (instHMul.hMul b ε)))
          (Or (Real.instLE.le 0 (instHMul.hMul c ε)) (Real.instLE.le 0 (instHMul.hMul d ε))))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_squarefree_diag_isotropic

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (w : ι → Rat),

    Exists fun s =>
      And (∀ (i : ι), Squarefree (s i))
        (And (∀ (i : ι), Ne (s i) 0)
          (Iff
            (Exists fun x => And (Ne x 0) (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHMul.hMul (w i) (instHPow.hPow (x i) 2)) 0))
            (Exists fun x =>
              And (Ne x 0) (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHMul.hMul (s i).cast (instHPow.hPow (x i) 2)) 0))))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_squarefree_sq_mul_int

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_ternary_isotropic_odd
type:

      IsUnit a →

          Exists fun X =>
            Exists fun Y =>
              Exists fun Z =>
                And (IsUnit Z)
                  (Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul a (instHPow.hPow X 2)) (instHMul.hMul b (instHPow.hPow Y 2)))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_ternary_zero_same_parity_padic

        Ne b 0 →
          Ne c 0 →
            Eq (instHMod.hMod a.valuation 2) (instHMod.hMod b.valuation 2) →
              Eq (instHMod.hMod b.valuation 2) (instHMod.hMod c.valuation 2) →
                Exists fun x =>
                  Exists fun y =>
                    Exists fun z =>
                      And (Not (And (Eq x 0) (And (Eq y 0) (Eq z 0))))
                        (Eq
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul a (instHPow.hPow x 2)) (instHMul.hMul b (instHPow.hPow y 2)))

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_three_same_parity

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_unit_of_odd_partner

        Eq (dotProduct v (M.mulVec w)) 1 →
          ∀ (k : Int),
            Eq (dotProduct w (M.mulVec w)) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 k) 1) →

name: SKEFTHawking.exists_unit_of_orthogonal_odd
type:

  Eq M.transpose M →
    ∀ (v w z' : Fin n → Int),
      Eq (dotProduct v (M.mulVec v)) 0 →
        Eq (dotProduct v (M.mulVec w)) 1 →
          Eq (dotProduct w (M.mulVec w)) 0 →
            Eq (dotProduct v (M.mulVec z')) 0 →
              Eq (dotProduct w (M.mulVec z')) 0 →
                ∀ (k : Int),
                  Eq (dotProduct z' (M.mulVec z')) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 k) 1) →
                    And
                      (Eq
                        (dotProduct v
                          (M.mulVec (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd z' (instHSMul.hSMul (Int.instNegInt.neg k) v)) w)))
                        1)
                      (Eq
                        (dotProduct (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd z' (instHSMul.hSMul (Int.instNegInt.neg k) v)) w)
                          (M.mulVec (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd z' (instHSMul.hSMul (Int.instNegInt.neg k) v)) w)))
                        1)

name: SKEFTHawking.ext_algebraic_input
type:
And (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul SKEFTHawking.A1.d1 SKEFTHawking.A1.d2) 0)

      (∀ (y : Fin d → Real),
          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul lam (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHPow.hPow (y i) 2))
            (dotProduct y (G.mulVec y))) →
        ∀ {x : Fin d → Real},
          Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHPow.hPow (x i) 2) (instHPow.hPow R 2) →
            ∀ (γ : Fin d → Real),
              Real.instLE.le
                (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv lam 2) (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHPow.hPow (γ i) 2))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 lam) (instHPow.hPow R 2)))
                (dotProduct (instHAdd.hAdd x γ) (G.mulVec (instHAdd.hAdd x γ)))

type:
∀ {m : Nat} (G : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) Int),
  Eq G.transpose G →
    SKEFTHawking.IsUnimodular G →
      ∀ (e₁ f₁ e₂ w' : Fin m → Int) (p q : Int),
        Eq (dotProduct e₁ (G.mulVec e₁)) 0 →
          Eq (dotProduct f₁ (G.mulVec f₁)) 0 →
            Eq (dotProduct e₁ (G.mulVec f₁)) 1 →
              Eq (dotProduct e₂ (G.mulVec e₂)) 0 →
                Eq (dotProduct e₁ (G.mulVec e₂)) 0 →
                  Eq (dotProduct f₁ (G.mulVec e₂)) 0 →
                    Eq (dotProduct f₁ (G.mulVec w')) (instHMul.hMul (dotProduct e₂ (G.mulVec w')) p) →
                      Eq (dotProduct e₁ (G.mulVec w')) (instHMul.hMul (dotProduct e₂ (G.mulVec w')) q) →
                        Exists fun T =>
                          And (IsUnit T.det)
                            (And
                              (Eq
                                (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                                  (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul T.transpose G) T)
                                G)
                              (And (Eq (dotProduct e₁ (G.mulVec (T.mulVec w'))) 0)
                                (Eq (dotProduct f₁ (G.mulVec (T.mulVec w'))) 0)))

  Ne A 0 →
    Ne B 0 →
      (Exists fun x =>
          Exists fun y =>
            Exists fun z =>
              And (Not (And (Eq x 0) (And (Eq y 0) (Eq z 0))))
                (Eq (instHPow.hPow z 2)
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul A.cast (instHPow.hPow x 2))
                    (instHMul.hMul B.cast (instHPow.hPow y 2))))) →
        (∀ (p : Nat) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
            Exists fun x =>
              Exists fun y =>
                Exists fun z =>
                  And (Not (And (Eq x 0) (And (Eq y 0) (Eq z 0))))
                    (Eq (instHPow.hPow z 2)
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul A.cast (instHPow.hPow x 2))
                        (instHMul.hMul B.cast (instHPow.hPow y 2))))) →
          Exists fun x =>
            Exists fun y =>
              Exists fun z =>
                And (Not (And (Eq x 0) (And (Eq y 0) (Eq z 0))))
                  (Eq (instHPow.hPow z 2)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul A (instHPow.hPow x 2)) (instHMul.hMul B (instHPow.hPow y 2))))

  semigroupDvd.dvd p.cast X →
    semigroupDvd.dvd p.cast Y →
      semigroupDvd.dvd p.cast Z →
        Eq (instHPow.hPow Z 2)
            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul u (instHPow.hPow X 2))
              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul p.cast v) (instHPow.hPow Y 2))) →
          Exists fun X' =>
            Exists fun Y' =>
              Exists fun Z' =>
                And (Eq X (instHMul.hMul p.cast X'))
                  (And (Eq Y (instHMul.hMul p.cast Y'))
                    (And (Eq Z (instHMul.hMul p.cast Z'))
                      (Eq (instHPow.hPow Z' 2)
                        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul u (instHPow.hPow X' 2))
                          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul p.cast v) (instHPow.hPow Y' 2))))))

    ∀ {u v : K},

          (Exists fun x =>
            Exists fun y =>
              Exists fun z =>
                And (Not (And (Eq x 0) (And (Eq y 0) (Eq z 0))))
                  (Eq (instHPow.hPow z 2)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 u) (instHPow.hPow x 2))
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 v) (instHPow.hPow y 2)))))
          (Exists fun x =>
            Exists fun y =>
              Exists fun z =>
                And (Not (And (Eq x 0) (And (Eq y 0) (Eq z 0))))
                  (Eq (instHPow.hPow z 2)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 u) (instHPow.hPow x 2))

∀ {n : Nat} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Int),
  Eq M.transpose M →
    ∀ (x : Fin n → Int)
      (hfr :
        Eq (Module.finrank Int (Subtype fun x_1 => SetLike.instMembership.mem (SKEFTHawking.unitPerp M x) x_1))
          (instHSub.hSub n 1)),
      Eq (SKEFTHawking.unitResidGram M x hfr).transpose (SKEFTHawking.unitResidGram M x hfr)

name: SKEFTHawking.unitResidGram_transport
type:
∀ {n : Nat} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Int) (x : Fin n → Int)
  (hfr :
    Eq (Module.finrank Int (Subtype fun x_1 => SetLike.instMembership.mem (SKEFTHawking.unitPerp M x) x_1))
      (instHSub.hSub n 1))
  (c c' : Fin (instHSub.hSub n 1) → Int),
  Eq
    (dotProduct
      (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
        instHSMul.hSMul (c i) (Module.Basis.instFunLike.coe (SKEFTHawking.unitPerpBasis M x hfr) i).val)
      (M.mulVec
        (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
          instHSMul.hSMul (c' j) (Module.Basis.instFunLike.coe (SKEFTHawking.unitPerpBasis M x hfr) j).val)))
    (dotProduct c ((SKEFTHawking.unitResidGram M x hfr).mulVec c'))

name: SKEFTHawking.unit_correct_by_hyp_pair
type:
∀ {n : Nat} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Int),
  Eq M.transpose M →
    ∀ (ε : Int) (x v w : Fin n → Int),
      Eq (dotProduct x (M.mulVec x)) ε →
        Eq (dotProduct x (M.mulVec v)) 0 →
          Eq (dotProduct x (M.mulVec w)) 0 →
            Eq (dotProduct v (M.mulVec v)) 0 →
              Eq (dotProduct v (M.mulVec w)) 1 →
                Eq (dotProduct w (M.mulVec w)) 0 →
                  And (Eq (dotProduct (instHAdd.hAdd x w) (M.mulVec (instHAdd.hAdd x w))) ε)
                    (And (Eq (dotProduct (instHAdd.hAdd x w) (M.mulVec (instHSub.hSub x (instHSMul.hSMul ε v)))) 0)
                      (Eq
                        (dotProduct (instHSub.hSub x (instHSMul.hSMul ε v))
                          (M.mulVec (instHSub.hSub x (instHSMul.hSMul ε v))))
                        ε))

      ∀ (y : Fin n → Int),

name: SKEFTHawking.unit_split_congr
type:
∀ {n : Nat} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Int),
  Eq M.transpose M →
    SKEFTHawking.IsUnimodular M →
      ∀ (ε : Int),
        Or (Eq ε 1) (Eq ε (-1)) →
          ∀ (x : Fin n → Int),
            Eq (dotProduct x (M.mulVec x)) ε →
              Exists fun M' =>
                Exists fun e =>
                  And
                    (SKEFTHawking.IntCongr M
                      (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (Matrix.reindex e e)
                        (Matrix.fromBlocks
                          (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe Matrix.of
                            (Matrix.vecCons (Matrix.vecCons ε Matrix.vecEmpty) Matrix.vecEmpty))
                          0 0 M')))
                    (And (Eq M'.transpose M')
                      (And (SKEFTHawking.IsUnimodular M')
                        (Eq (SKEFTHawking.latticeSig M') (instHSub.hSub (SKEFTHawking.latticeSig M) ε))))

name: SKEFTHawking.unit_split_congr_of_finrank
type:
∀ {n : Nat} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Int),
  Eq M.transpose M →
    SKEFTHawking.IsUnimodular M →
      ∀ (ε : Int),
        Or (Eq ε 1) (Eq ε (-1)) →
          ∀ (x : Fin n → Int),
            Eq (dotProduct x (M.mulVec x)) ε →
              ∀
                (hfr :
                  Eq
                    (Module.finrank Int (Subtype fun x_1 => SetLike.instMembership.mem (SKEFTHawking.unitPerp M x) x_1))
                    (instHSub.hSub n 1)),
                Exists fun e =>
                  And
                    (SKEFTHawking.IntCongr M
                      (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (Matrix.reindex e e)
                        (Matrix.fromBlocks
                          (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe Matrix.of
                            (Matrix.vecCons (Matrix.vecCons ε Matrix.vecEmpty) Matrix.vecEmpty))
                          0 0 (SKEFTHawking.unitResidGram M x hfr))))
                    (And (SKEFTHawking.IsUnimodular (SKEFTHawking.unitResidGram M x hfr))
                      (Eq (SKEFTHawking.latticeSig (SKEFTHawking.unitResidGram M x hfr))
                        (instHSub.hSub (SKEFTHawking.latticeSig M) ε)))

name: limiting_cor
type:
∀ {A : Real} {G : Complex → Complex} {f : Nat → Complex} (ψ : CS 2 Complex),
  (∀ (σ' : Real), Real.instLT.lt 1 σ' → Summable (nterm f σ')) →
    cheby f →
      ContinuousOn G (setOf fun s => Real.instLE.le 1 s.re) →
        Set.EqOn G (fun s => instHSub.hSub (LSeries f s) (instHDiv.hDiv (Complex.ofReal A) (instHSub.hSub s 1)))
            (setOf fun s => Real.instLT.lt 1 s.re) →
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun x =>
              instHSub.hSub
                (tsum fun n =>
                  instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv (f n) n.cast)
                    (Real.instFourierTransform.fourier ψ.toFun
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)) (Real.log (instHDiv.hDiv n.cast x)))))
                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal A)
                  (MeasureTheory.integral (Real.measureSpace.volume.restrict (Set.Ici (Real.instNeg.neg (Real.log x))))
                    fun u => Real.instFourierTransform.fourier ψ.toFun (instHDiv.hDiv u (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)))))
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: limiting_fourier
type:
∀ {A x : Real} {G : Complex → Complex} {f : Nat → Complex},
  cheby f →
    ContinuousOn G (setOf fun s => Real.instLE.le 1 s.re) →
      Set.EqOn G (fun s => instHSub.hSub (LSeries f s) (instHDiv.hDiv (Complex.ofReal A) (instHSub.hSub s 1)))
          (setOf fun s => Real.instLT.lt 1 s.re) →
        (∀ (σ' : Real), Real.instLT.lt 1 σ' → Summable (nterm f σ')) →
          ∀ (ψ : CS 2 Complex),
            Real.instLE.le 1 x →
              Eq
                (instHSub.hSub
                  (tsum fun n =>
                    instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv (f n) n.cast)
                      (Real.instFourierTransform.fourier ψ.toFun
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi))
                          (Real.log (instHDiv.hDiv n.cast x)))))
                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal A)
                    (MeasureTheory.integral
                      (Real.measureSpace.volume.restrict (Set.Ici (Real.instNeg.neg (Real.log x)))) fun u =>
                      Real.instFourierTransform.fourier ψ.toFun (instHDiv.hDiv u (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)))))
                (MeasureTheory.integral Real.measureSpace.volume fun t =>
                  instHMul.hMul
                    (instHMul.hMul (G (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal t) Complex.I))) (ψ.toFun t))
                    (instHPow.hPow (Complex.ofReal x) (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal t) Complex.I)))

name: limiting_fourier_aux
type:
∀ {A x : Real} {G : Complex → Complex} {f : Nat → Complex},
  Set.EqOn G (fun s => instHSub.hSub (LSeries f s) (instHDiv.hDiv (Complex.ofReal A) (instHSub.hSub s 1)))
      (setOf fun s => Real.instLT.lt 1 s.re) →
    (∀ (σ' : Real), Real.instLT.lt 1 σ' → Summable (nterm f σ')) →
      ∀ (ψ : CS 2 Complex),
        Real.instLE.le 1 x →
          ∀ (σ' : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 1 σ' →
              Eq
                (instHSub.hSub
                  (tsum fun n =>
                    instHMul.hMul (LSeries.term f (Complex.ofReal σ') n)
                      (Real.instFourierTransform.fourier ψ.toFun
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi))
                          (Real.log (instHDiv.hDiv n.cast x)))))
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal A) (Complex.ofReal (instHPow.hPow x (instHSub.hSub 1 σ'))))
                    (MeasureTheory.integral
                      (Real.measureSpace.volume.restrict (Set.Ici (Real.instNeg.neg (Real.log x)))) fun u =>
                      instHMul.hMul
                        (Complex.ofReal (Real.exp (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg u) (instHSub.hSub σ' 1))))
                        (Real.instFourierTransform.fourier ψ.toFun (instHDiv.hDiv u (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi))))))
                (MeasureTheory.integral Real.measureSpace.volume fun t =>
                  instHMul.hMul
                    (instHMul.hMul (G (instHAdd.hAdd (Complex.ofReal σ') (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal t) Complex.I)))
                      (ψ.toFun t))
                    (instHPow.hPow (Complex.ofReal x) (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal t) Complex.I)))
